title: System Integration & Test Engineer, Amazon Leo for Government (ALG), SEIT | MFG
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is a visionary initiative within Amazon that aims to revolutionize global connectivity through the development of a state-of-the-art Low Earth Orbit (LEO) interconnected satellite communication constellation. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide by delivering high-speed, low latency, internet services to underserved and unserved communities and remote communities around the world. By leveraging cutting-edge satellite technology, we are working towards a future where everyone has access to reliable and high-quality internet connectivity regardless of their location.

The Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering organization is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted government and international customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. ALG Engineering leads the development and delivery of targeted and scalable solutions for custom space and terrestrial applications. ALG collaborates closely with Amazon Leo to leverage the constellation of advanced satellites to provide seamless and efficient communication capabilities to meet the needs of our customers. The ALG Engineering team is seeking highly technical and talented individuals who are passionate about creating unique solutions that result in a positive impact on a global scale.

The System Integration & Test (I&T) Engineer will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary team to design, integrate, and test innovative product solutions. The System I&T Engineer will work closely with colleagues throughout Amazon Leo’s inter-disciplinary team and collaborate with key partners and suppliers to ensure our system exceeds customer expectations. The System I&T Engineer must be responsive, flexible, innovative, and able to succeed within a collaborative, fast-paced, and dynamic environment.

As a member of the ALG Engineering Systems Engineering, Integration, Test, and Manufacturing organization, the System I&T Engineer will be responsible for developing the architecture and executing the design, build, and validation of test systems for complex systems and subsystems. The candidate will have the capabilities to develop test procedures, test software, test scripts, APIs, and automation to enable test and verification at various products levels including but not limited to system-on-chip (SoC) calibration algorithm verification, test automation and data analysis for electronics, opto-mechanical/opto-electrical subsystems, and system level tests including environmental tests. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the test architecture supports all aspects of the integration, test, verification, and validation of one or more of the following: the satellite bus, RF payloads, optical payloads, custom ground terminals, or custom user terminals. This includes testing, analyzing, and optimizing the test support equipment to the particular satellite or ground element being developed. Testing efforts include functional and performance testing through various environmental conditions as required and it will be the candidate’s responsibility to ensure the test systems enable efficient test execution and requirements verification.

The ideal candidate has a strong technical background in space and ground systems design, integration, and verification across the development lifecycle. This candidate should enjoy taking ownership over complex problems and delivering well-executed results of high-quality and can work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that provides significant autonomy to be creative in devising and verifying various engineering approaches to meet technical and programmatic requirements.




Key job responsibilities
• Provide System and Software Integration and Test leadership to one or more of the following: the satellite bus, RF payloads, optical payloads, custom ground terminals, or custom user terminals.
• Provide system-level test design technical expertise to one or more of the following products and services: satellite bus, RF payloads, optical payloads, custom ground terminals, or custom user terminals.
• Specify and develop end-to-end payload or sub-system integration and test plans and procedures to validate performance against customer and/or partner requirements
• Create test algorithms, test scripts, automation and calibration routines for test systems as part of performing lab and field evaluation of integrated satellites, bus, payloads or sub-systems
• Analyze system and software test data and engage with cross functionally with teammates, partners, suppliers, or customers to evaluate the product performance and provide proactive feedback on potential improvements.
• Architect, design, and validate test software and hardware for mechanical, optical, and electrical support equipment necessary to enable test execution and requirements verification
• Prepare reports documenting test results, test coverage, performance results and other key performance indicator (KPI) metrics, and communicate issues effectively with developers and managers
• Effectively manage and track to closure test anomalies, defects, and bugs; Debug, root-cause, and make continuous improvements of control systems in a high-rate production environment

US Citizen only: This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.
Clearable Roles: This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.
Cleared Roles: This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance.





About the team
Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. These solutions are tailored to meet the needs of government and international customers for both space-based and terrestrial applications. The Systems Engineering, Integration, Test, and Manufacturing organization under ALG Engineering plays a vital role in the entire life cycle of the development of an engineering solution, including architecture development, requirements and interface definition through assembly, integration, and test (AI&T), verification, and post-delivery and operational support.

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, physics, or equivalent
- 8+ years of experience in space vehicle, bus, RF payload, optical payload, or ground terminal integration and test or related industry experience, with focus on system and software integration and test

- 6+ years of experience developing code in C, C++, Matlab, LabVIEW, Python, Docker, Rust on Linux platforms and experience with industry standard coding practices
- 5+ years of experience building complex test systems including integrating test software

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in cloud infrastructures (AWS) with strong working knowledge of IPv4/IPv6 subnetting and L1-L6 networking

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma

- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Experience with an industrial wellness program

title: Controls Integration Engineer, One MHS | Systems Integration and Flow
descriptionHtml:
The Controls Integration Engineer is responsible for the on-site deployment, integration, and commissioning of automated material handling equipment such as sorters, conveyor systems, and Automated work cells. This role is highly execution-focused and hands-on, owning the technical bring-up of Industrial PCs (IPCs), PLCs, industrial networks, and field devices during installation and commissioning phases.
The engineer serves as a technical authority on-site, partnering closely with contractors, system integrators, vendors, and internal engineering teams to ensure systems are installed, tested, and commissioned safely, reliably, and in accordance with project standards and operational requirements.



Key job responsibilities
Deployment & Commissioning
• Execute on-site commissioning activities for sorters, conveyors, and automated work cells.
• Provision, configure, and validate Linux-based IPCs, PLCs, HMIs, industrial networks, and field devices per project standards.
• Perform I/O checkouts, network validation, and phased system bring-up activities.
• Execute commissioning and test plans, including sequencing, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
• Support dry runs, functional testing, and integrated system testing through startup and handover.
Troubleshooting & Technical Support
• Serve as the primary on-site technical resource for controls, networking, and system integration issues.
• Diagnose and resolve industrial networking problems (e.g., IP conflicts, VLAN issues, switch configuration, fieldbus communication faults).
• Troubleshoot PLC logic, device configuration, safety interlocks, and system-level faults across electrical, controls, and mechanical boundaries.
• Perform structured root-cause analysis and support implementation of permanent corrective actions.
• Document issues, resolutions, and lessons learned to support continuous improvement and future deployments.
On-Site Technical Leadership
• Provide day-to-day technical direction to technicians, electricians, and commissioning support personnel during system deployment.
• Coordinate closely with system integrators, OEMs, and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues and unblock progress.
• Ensure compliance with safety requirements, quality standards, and commissioning best practices during installation and testing.
Integration & Handover
• Validate equipment functionality against design specifications, controls standards, and operational requirements.
• Support integration of equipment into Warehouse Control Systems (WCS) and higher-level orchestration layers.
• Participate in turnover activities, ensuring systems are stable, documented, and ready for operational ownership.
Continuous Improvement
• Identify opportunities to improve commissioning efficiency, reliability, and repeatability.
• Contribute to the development and refinement of commissioning tools, test procedures, and deployment standards.
• Provide feedback to design and integration teams to improve future system designs and deployment outcomes.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with networking fundamentals including hands-on experience with load balancers, switches, routers, etc.
- Willingness to travel up to 50% for on-site commissioning and deployment support.
- Hands-on experience with industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet/IP, Profinet, EtherCAT, or Modbus TCP.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- Familiarity with object-oriented programming concepts in an IEC 61131-3 environment (e.g., structured function blocks, reusable control architectures).
- Experience supporting large-scale commissioning projects such as automated warehouses, conveyor and sorter systems, or complex manufacturing environments.

Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks — from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Leo Customer Terminal Application and Networking Team builds the on-device software that runs on the customer's antenna and turns it into a fast, reliable, self-diagnosing internet gateway. title: Masters in Engineering OR MBA – Promotion 2026: Pathways Operations Manager (Leadership Accelerator Program)
descriptionHtml:
Launch your career with Amazon by solving complex operational challenges that impact millions of customers worldwide. As an Operations Manager in our Pathways Program, designed for recent MBA or Masters in Engineering grads ready to make an immediate impact, you'll lead cross-functional teams, manage people, processes, and technology, and drive continuous improvement across one of the most innovative operations environments globally.

From Day 1, you'll work on real business challenges, optimizing operations, enhancing the customer experience, and implementing scalable solutions across our global network. This is your opportunity to develop strategic leadership capabilities while building expertise in one of the world's most complex operational environments.

PROGRAM OVERVIEW:

Pathways is Amazon's three-year Operations Leadership Development Program, designed to cultivate the next generation of senior operations leadership at Amazon. Participants will gain high visibility with senior executives while tackling challenging assignments across diverse sites, technologies, and geographies within our world-class operations network.

Day to day, participants will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex operational challenges, take on progressively greater responsibilities, and work on real business initiatives that directly impact our operations. Along the way, participants will learn from experienced leaders, participate in cohort-based learning sessions, and build a network of peers who will become their professional community throughout their career at Amazon.

This program is designed to build global leadership capabilities and prepare participants for executive-level impact.

This role is for Pathways positions at Amazon operations facilities across Italy. Successful candidates will work with their recruiter to be matched to a site prior to receiving an offer.

Candidates who apply to multiple Amazon MBA OR Masters in Engineering roles will only be selected to interview for one.


WHAT TO EXPECT:

Step 1: Area Manager - Hit the ground running by leading 50–100 associates on the front lines of one of Amazon's world-class fulfillment, sortation, or delivery centers. This is where you'll build your operational foundation: learning how to lead people and systems at scale.

Step 2: Operations Manager - Take on greater responsibility by leading and developing other managers. You'll drive process improvements and collaborate cross-functionally across your site, region, and network.

Step 3: Senior Operations Manager - Graduate from the program as a senior leader known for operational excellence. In this role, you'll lead through others to execute regional or network-level initiatives, whether that's launching a new business, leading a major project, or running an entire site.

During the first three years, candidates should expect to work weekends, holidays, and/or overnight shifts.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon has built a reputation for excellence with a mission to be the earth's most customer-centric company a company that customers from all over the globe will recognize value and trust for both our products and our service. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is carrying on that tradition while leading the world in cloud technologies.

The AWS Incident Detection and Response team is part of the ASPIRE organisation within AWS Support and is dedicated to offering eligible AWS Enterprise Support customers proactive engagement and incident management to reduce the potential for failure and to accelerate recovery of critical workloads from disruption. We achieve these objectives by working closely with customers to develop runbooks and response plans customized to the context of each workload onboarded to the service. Onboarded workloads are monitored 24x7 by a team of Incident Management Engineers (IMEs) to detect and engage customers on a call bridge within 5 minutes of a critical alarm.

ABOUT YOU Incident Management Engineers have a broad skill set with demonstrated career progression and a proven track record of delivering results. The successful candidate will possess strong analytical acumen solid technology experience superb business judgment strategic account ownership and a propensity to dive deep to solve complex problems. You will also have a passion for creating/providing a world class experience for our customers. The candidate must understand the competitive and industry landscape and must have the leadership presence and communication skills to effectively work with customers at all levels of their organization. You must be a self-starter and able to execute at both a tactical and strategic level - with a strong attention to detail. This is a global role that requires excellent written and verbal communication skills and a passion and desire for leading the resolution of critical incidents. Your decisions are not only fundamental to helping protect our most critical customers but will help maintain the health of AWS customers worldwide.

Finally you are passionate about technology with a desire to learn more and do more with AWS.

ABOUT THE ROLE AWS Support is looking for a leader with a strong background in Incident Management and customer ownership to be there during the moments that matter for our most critical customers. We are looking for an Incident Management Engineer to join our team to provide incident response and account ownership. In this position you will play a pivotal role in providing communication emergency response technical resolver engagement and incident management for our customers.

Please note as a follow-the-sun organisation IMEs work the core hours of 8am-4pm PST GMT-8 / PDT GMT-7. Successful applicants will be required to work some weekends (Sunday to Thursday or Tuesday to Saturday) and public holidays.

Key job responsibilities
• Every day will bring new and exciting challenges that include elements of:
• Drive the resolution of large scale customer impacting incidents as part of a team rotation
• Drive critical complex customer escalations in situations that are sometimes technically challenging in collaboration with Engineering Teams.
• Provide critical incident response/management (including leading calls with internal/external participants) for customer's critical workloads
• Contribute to Problem Records for customers
• Conduct continuous real-time proactive monitoring of customer metrics
• Prioritize manage and own emerging and developing customer issues from start to finish
• Monitor and manage communications during high impact events via relevant channels
• Collaborate with key stakeholders across AWS to improve the customer experience and develop mechanisms that support operational excellence
• Lead projects and teams to drive operational improvements
• Create and review documentation; design/influence new standard operating procedures
• Identify and troubleshoot recurring platform issues and own projects to drive improvements
• Mentor peers in your areas of technical and operational strength
• Perform other duties as required by the organization

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: Construction Manager
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon's Data Center Construction Manager (CM) delivers hyperscale data center projects from feasibility through commissioning handover — owning scope, schedule, and budget across new builds and capital upgrades in the Greater Seoul region. Amazon designs and procures its most advanced infrastructure in-house and builds data centers purpose-built for our own servers. As part of a dedicated, self-perform construction team, you will operate in a global environment with end-to-end ownership of the entire critical infrastructure chain: HV substations, fiber, generators, switchgear, UPS, chillers, cooling towers, AHUs, and servers. This end-to-end ownership demands a CM who can synthesize complex MEP systems and the control systems that integrate them, hold general contractors (GCs) accountable to quality standards, and compress timelines without sacrificing safety or resilience. Once construction is complete, the CM transitions the facility to the commissioning team and supports integrated testing through to handover. You will work within a high-velocity, multi-disciplinary team — acting as both an individual project owner and a technical authority in your discipline.

Key job responsibilities
Deliver:
- Own full-lifecycle project delivery
- Manage scope, cost, schedule, and quality for concurrent new-build and capital projects
- Direct day-to-day contractor performance, quality, safety compliance, and change management on site — travel to project sites for audits, constructability reviews, and commissioning support as required
- Manage the RFI lifecycle and coordinate technical resolution with design engineers
- Manage contracts and commercial change: scope compliance, variations, EOTs, claims, and progress claims support (with QS/commercial/legal teams)
- Liaise with authorities and utility providers for permits and regulatory compliance
- Report project metrics, risks, and decisions to senior leadership with clarity and precision
Optimize:
- Identify and execute cost-reduction and schedule-compression opportunities across assigned projects
- Manage procurement lifecycle from tender to contract award in accordance with company procurement policy
- Develop scopes of work, equipment specifications, RFPs, and capital expenditure justifications
- Drive constructability reviews on electrical, mechanical, and architectural designs
Comply:
- Implement risk, issue, and change management processes to mitigate delivery risks
- Ensure project adherence to internal governance, quality assurance, regulatory, and security standards
- Ensure compliance with global EHS policies and high-risk activity standards
- Maintain project risk registers with mitigation plans and regular stakeholder reporting
Influence:
- Serve as the primary project-level point of contact for cross-functional teams (Engineering, Network, Security, Operations, Finance, Procurement) to drive alignment and decision-making
- Support and upskill on-site stakeholders, and partner with procurement to expand the vendor pool
- Lead cross-functional initiatives to increase facility resiliency and operational performance

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of construction or project management experience
- Business-level fluency in Korean and English, including the ability to communicate technical concepts in writing and verbally with internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
- Knowledge of critical data center equipment

title: Area Manager:in
descriptionHtml:
Der operative Geschäftsbereich ist das Herz von Amazon. Dieser wesentliche Teil unseres Unternehmens sorgt dafür, dass wir Bestellungen effizient versenden, damit unsere Kund:innen ihre Artikel rechtzeitig erhalten. Als Area Manager:in sorgst Du dafür, dass alle Abläufe an Deinem Standort so reibungslos wie möglich funktionieren, damit wir die Kundennachfrage erfüllen können. Du führst ein Team, das für die Sicherheit, Effizienz und erstklassige Qualität unserer Betriebsabläufe sorgt. Zusätzlich leitest Du eine Reihe von Projekten in unserem gesamten Netzwerk, um die Produktivität zu fördern.

Key job responsibilities
- Erschaffen, Beaufsichtigen und Fördern einer Kultur der Sicherheit und des Wohlbefindens
- Analyse und Umsetzung von Änderungen, um fortlaufend hohe Qualität und Produktivität zu gewährleisten
- Beaufsichtigung von Projekten zur Verschlankung von Prozessen, Optimierung der Produktivität und Verbesserung der Servicequalität für Kund:innen in Deinem Verantwortungsbereich
- Analyse der Schichten laut Unternehmensvorgaben und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung unserer Operational Excellence
- Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen auf Führungsebene, um Schichtverfahren zu vereinheitlichen

A day in the life
Du arbeitest im Schichtbetrieb an einem unserer Standorte und sorgst dafür, dass die dortigen Abläufe so produktiv wie möglich sind. Schwerpunkt Deiner Tätigkeit ist die Leitung und Förderung einer Sicherheitskultur sowie die Aufrechterhaltung der Qualität und der Leistungsstandards der Arbeitsschichten. Du beaufsichtigst außerdem die Prozessverbesserungen in Deinem Bereich und organisierst die Umsetzung. Ein typischer Arbeitstag kann ganz unterschiedlich aussehen und umfasst sowohl routinemäßiges Teammanagement und tägliche Betriebsaufgaben als auch Prozessverbesserung und weitreichende operative Aufgaben für den Eventualfall. Außerdem agierst Du als Vorbild und Mentor für neue Manager:innen.

About the team
Amazon Logistik (AMZL) ist für die Auslieferung von Millionen von Produkten unserer Kunden und Kundinnen direkt an die Haustür verantwortlich. Die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ liefert unsere Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern und realisiert zahlreiche Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von Kunden zufrieden zu stellen.
Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Unsere Arbeit lässt sich in zwei Sparten unterteilen. „Under the Roof“ betrifft alles was innerhalb unserer Logistikstandorte passiert und „On the Road“ alles was in den Liefergebieten auf der Straße stattfindet. Unsere Mitarbeitenden bereiten die Pakete in entsprechenden Schichten (Nacht, Früh, Spät) auf den täglichen Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor und kümmern sich um Retouren, die nicht ausgeliefert werden konnten.
Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

- Studienabschluss
- Führungserfahrung
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Kolleg:innen und Führungskräften
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Verwendung von Daten oder anekdotischer Evidenz zur Begründung von geschäftlichen Entscheidungen
- Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Lean-, Six-Sigma- und Kaizen-Methoden
- Erfahrung mit der Arbeit in einem anderen Logistikumfeld
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit der MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

Key job responsibilities

Jako stażysta w dziale operacji Amazon będziesz mieć możliwość wykorzystania swoich umiejętności analitycznych w ważnych projektach, które poprawiają funkcjonalność i jakość usług centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania i stacji dostaw.
Kluczowe obowiązki stanowiska:

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role:
As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll mentor junior engineers and lead cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems, implement innovative projects, and develop system design improvements to enhance site throughput. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your technical leadership and design optimization efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy while building team capabilities and driving operational excellence.

What Do We Offer?
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will apply Subject Matter Expertise (SME) on troubleshooting and dive deeps for engineering issues, supporting automation engineers to investigate the root cause and planning actions to eliminate/mitigate the downtime of critical assets
- You will collaborate with building Operations, Operations Engineering teams, FC Start-up Team, AFT Software teams, ACES team, and Safety to support MHE systems optimization and project implementation
- You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
- You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations
- You will provide escalation support to automation engineers, during and after business hours, troubleshooting locally and remotely, to ensure that all hardware or controls software within the building is repaired on time
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 4+ years of PLC programming or automation engineering experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 4+ years of process or production environment related PLC-controlled automation and issue diagnosis experience
- 4+ years of robotics work cells and control systems experience
- 4+ years of Siemens, Allen-Bradley or Codesys Ladder Logic and structure programming experience
- 4+ years of electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment experience

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent
- Master's degree, or Six Sigma Black Belt certification
- Experience leading controls in manufacturing or complex industrial environments
- Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modifying Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components
- Experience interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings

title: Software Development Engineer, Agentic Workspaces - Watchtower
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon WorkSpaces has protected and empowered enterprise work for over a decade and we are now reimagining what a workspace is. We are building Agentic WorkSpaces: a platform where the workspace itself is an active partner in how you work not just infrastructure that delivers applications. Today more than a million users rely on WorkSpaces daily; tomorrow those WorkSpaces will host AI agents alongside humans—agents that code, troubleshoot, analyze, and act on behalf of their users governed by the same identity and security policies as the people they serve. We compete with Microsoft Citrix and Omnissa and we intend to leapfrog them by building the workspace that was designed for the agentic era not retrofitted for it.

Agentic WorkSpaces' Watchtower team is the layer that makes this possible from the inside of every WorkSpace: telemetry, health, secure communications both inbound and outbound, Agentic AI platforms for qualification of operating systems instances and applications. Our mission is to provide robust monitoring automation and operational capabilities that ensure the reliability and performance of WorkSpaces Instances. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design build and operate the services that secure and maintain WorkSpaces for humans and increasingly for the AI agents that work beside them across every supported OS and identity provider. You will own end-to-end delivery of features and systems within Watchtower - from design through deployment and operations - holding a high bar for availability latency and security.

You are customer-obsessed technically deep and energized by solving hard problems. You think big about what the workspace of the future looks like - a unified agent shipping to two platforms from one codebase an identity model that treats human and agents as first-class citizens and autonomous troubleshooting that resolves issues before users notice - and then you build the systems to get there. You thrive in ambiguity make sound trade-off decisions with incomplete information and hold yourself accountable for results that matter. You want to solve challenging problems in operating systems identity AI and desktop platform engineering at a scale that impacts more than a million users daily.

Key job responsibilities
• : In our team you will indulge your love of diving deep into complex technical problems driving incremental system optimizations and raising the bar for operational excellence and development practices. We will look to you to help enhance the skills and expertise of those around you.

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. title: Sr Integration Experience Mgr, Corporate Development Integration
descriptionHtml:
Corporate Development Integration is seeking an experienced integration communications and onboarding leader to drive adoption of functional and business integration activities in Amazon's mergers and acquisitions (M&A).

Amazon's integration leaders in this space are called Integration Experience (IX) Leads as they focus on minimizing disruption and driving engagement for acquired employees through internal communications, onboarding, training, cultural integration, and employee engagement strategies.

The IX Lead plans, creates, and executes integration enablement programs across the full integration lifecycle, from due diligence through approximately 90-100 days post-acquisition close. This role supports integrations of all sizes, both private and public company transactions, across multiple geographies, and managing multiple concurrent integration programs. Leveraging change management best practices, the IX Lead focuses on accelerating time to productivity for acquired organizations by delivering pragmatic, scalable support that is directly aligned to deal goals, navigating the ambiguity of M&A transactions and synthesizing input from business and cross-functional teams. Central to this role is supporting a culture of inclusion, trust, and respect in all working relationships—with acquired employees, cross-functional partners, and leadership alike.

This role supports global transactions, requiring domestic and international travel approximately 30% of the time. Due to the dynamic nature of M&A timelines, travel may occasionally be planned on short notice.


Key job responsibilities
Change Enablement & Integration Strategy
- Apply change management best practices to assess change readiness, identify potential friction points, and develop tailored enablement strategies based on deal complexity and anticipated change impact
- Translate functional and business integration activities into people-focused experiences through sequencing, prioritization, and stakeholder engagement
- Conduct cultural and change readiness assessments during due diligence, translating findings into actionable recommendations for communication, onboarding, and engagement strategies
- Define the scope of change support required for each transaction in partnership with the Integration Manager and Business Sponsor
- Identify opportunities to improve internal integration processes and scale best practices across the IX portfolio

Internal Communications
- Own the end-to-end employee communication strategy across the integration lifecycle, including employee newsletters and FAQs, leader briefing materials, and targeted messaging for specific employee groups
- Develop and execute comprehensive communication plans for key milestones (Deal Sign & Announcement, Deal Close & Day 1 Orientation), coordinating inputs from cross-functional teams (Business, Legal, PR, HR, IT, Finance, and Real Estate)
- Write and review all employee-facing communications ensuring clarity, consistency, and cross-functional alignment across stakeholders
- Develop executive communications that distill complex integration details into clear, compelling narratives
- Advise on organizational design communications, including sequencing and timing of reporting structure changes to manage employee experience

Onboarding & Training
- Plan and execute Day 1 Orientation events and customized onboarding experiences, including structured onboarding programs, leader onboarding programs, establishing a support network for the acquired population (onboarding buddies and key individuals to meet), and role-specific training
- Design and deliver comprehensive training plans in partnership with cross-functional teams, coordinating timing and sequencing to ensure a cohesive employee experience
- Equip Amazon and acquired company leaders to deliver integration messages through leader briefings and one-on-ones, enabling them to guide their teams through the transition
- Educate cross-functional partners and business teams on IX workstreams, integration milestones, and employee experience considerations

Cultural Integration
- Identify gaps between the acquired organization's operating norms and Amazon's ways of working, and develop integration strategies to bridge them
- Design and execute cultural integration approaches, including education on Amazon's Leadership Principles, Working Backwards methodology, business writing, and other ways of working
- Implement Change Champion Networks for large, complex transactions to support peer-to-peer adoption and sustained engagement

Stakeholder Engagement
- Build trusted relationships with senior leaders (Business Sponsors, VPs, acquired leadership) through direct engagement and consistent, communication
- Influence, advise, and build consensus among senior leadership in ambiguous situations, determining how to achieve the best outcome and knowing when and how to escalate effectively
- Keep cross-functional teams up-to-speed with proactive communication that anticipates questions

Employee Engagement & Measurement
- Own employee engagement measurement, including employee engagement pulse surveys, onboarding surveys, and integration surveys (~90-100 days post-close)
- Analyze employee sentiment data, identify themes, and present recommended actions to leadership, benchmarking results against historical acquisition data
- Use feedback loops to proactively address concerns, remove productivity barriers, and inform ongoing change support

About the team
The Corporate Development Integration team leads Amazon and acquired teams through the definition and enablement of the acquisition rationale and acquired business growth. Integration Experience (IX) Leads support this mission by planning, creating, and executing communications, onboarding, training, cultural integration, and employee engagement strategies that enable acquired organizations to adopt functional and business integration activities. Leveraging change management best practices, IX creates pragmatic integration enablement plans focused on ensuring acquired employees are informed, engaged, and supported throughout their initial integration journey with Amazon. We apply what's helpful, skip what's not, and stay solution-oriented, tailoring our approach based on deal complexity and business need.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
- 5+ years of professional or military experience
- Experience in advising and influencing executive leadership
- 8+ years of experience in change management, internal communications, employee engagement, organizational development, learning & enablement, or M&A integration – including designing and executing large-scale communication or onboarding programs
- Strong writing skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, compelling written narratives for executive audiences
- Experience applying change management methodologies to support organizational transitions
- Experience managing cross-functional programs with multiple concurrent workstreams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in M&A integration, organizational transformation, or large-scale business change
- Experience with employee engagement measurement, survey design, and data-driven action planning
- Track record of managing programs across multiple geographies and cultures
- Certification in change management (e.g., Prosci, CCMP), program management (e.g., PgMP, PMP), or strategic communications (e.g., IABC CMP, ABC)

descriptionHtml:

title: Design, Commissioning & Startup Safety Engineer, SR WHS Design, Construction & Startup
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Design & Startup Safety Program Manager within the Workplace, Health & Safety organization, you'll drive safety excellence across new facility launches. You will partner with Site Operations, Engineering, Real Estate, and Procurement teams to ensure every site implements Amazon WHS policies and meets regulatory requirements from day one.
You will support the safety aspect of design of new building templates, launches across all businesses by coordinating end-to-end lifecycle management of safety in design—from concept review through commissioning. You will execute standard work across AutoCAD layout evaluations, network-level equipment and process assessments, coordinate Factory Acceptance Testing, and ensure execution of WHS commissioning checklists. You will analyze safety performance data across buildings to identify design improvements and support strategic recommendations to leadership.
Drive Prevention through Design: Apply organizational safety engineering risk assessment methodology including risk tolerances. You will conduct comprehensive risk assessments and make recommendations to your manager and validate vendor safety solutions in partnership with engineering teams. You will apply ergonomics principles to equipment and process design. Your objective: eliminate risks before operations begin.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders: You will build trust with Engineering, New Site Project teams, Real Estate, Procurement, and Operations by communicating safety requirements clearly and effectively. Your ability to support change management processes will help embed safety standards into every new system and process across the organization.
This role requires travel up to 75% to conduct site visits, perform risk assessments, and coordinate commissioning activities across multiple facility launches. So I hope you're ready to see the world while making meaningful lasting impact at scale.


Key job responsibilities
Launch & Commissioning
• Execute WHS Launch Start-Up plans driving compliance with Amazon policies and local/federal regulations
• Coordinate WHS commissioning activities including site reviews, network-level equipment and process assessments, and Factory Acceptance Testing
• Track and complete action items from site visits with clear accountability and timelines
• Serve as WHS technical resource for launching sites
Design & Risk Management

• Apply organizational risk assessment methodology including risk tolerances
• Validate vendor technical safety solutions in partnership with engineering teams
• Analyze safety performance trends across buildings to identify design improvements and support recommendations to leadership
Stakeholder Collaboration
• Build trust and support change management with Engineering, Operations, Real Estate, and Procurement stakeholders
• Communicate technical safety requirements clearly and effectively to managers and senior leaders
• Partner with cross-functional teams to embed safety standards into new systems and processes

- Possess technical knowledge and the ability to engage with cross functional teams, transforming this knowledge into sound, compliant processes.

- Possess strong understanding of Ergonomics and the ability to use these principles in the review and design of equipment/processes.
- Review and interpret data and use this information to develop improvement plans within new processes.
- Conduct safety reviews of all new processes and equipment. Develop safety punch list items with all applicable business partners identifying, in detail, all safety issues and recommendations on how such opportunities can be addressed both short and long-term.

And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

descriptionHtml:

Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians and Facility Managers in all facets of their career

title: Snr. Civil Design Engineer, Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

You’ll collaborate with a diverse team of people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standard of safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. The Data Center Engineering (DCE) team is looking for a passionate, results-oriented, inventive Civil Engineer to drive design and construction in a client-side technical lead role for the delivery of our enterprise data center campus projects.

As a Civil Engineer, you will work as part of the wider DCE Team collaborating with our Real Estate, Design Services, Construction and other partner teams. You will be responsible for the successful delivery of design delivery ensuring we continue to meet and exceed our industry leading quality and performance requirements.

Utilizing your Civil Engineering expertise, you will assist in assessing site constraints, developing acceleration strategies and supporting overall campus planning, development and construction. This position ultimately plays a pivotal role for the delivery of Data Center projects.

The successful candidate will be strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly with a history of delivering for their customers. The role requires creative engineering balanced with high quality and customer focus. You must be able to work as part of a large and dynamic team, including many internal stakeholders, customers as well as external stakeholders like design consultants, developers and general contractors.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and communicate conceptual designs and create/maintain project documentation before, during, and after construction.
- Develop and maintain design standards, design prototypes, and template specifications related to site design.
- Review Due Diligence assessments to determine site constraints, risks and develop investigation scopes.
- Create, review, and release design consultant request for proposals.
- Manage our external civil design consultants through the design and construction process.
- Develop and review designs for grading, storm water, flood mitigation, utilities, and pavements.
- Deep understanding of interdependent civil design elements to develop optimised earthworks and utilities designs and minimise the construction schedule.
- Lead our internal modelling and documentation resources.
- Coordinate with internal and external Architecture, Structure and MEP design engineers.
- Effectively communicate design standards to internal and external project partners.
- Manage multiple fast paced projects simultaneously.
- Think outside of the box to find innovative solutions prior to and during the construction process to reduce costs without negative impacts on quality or reliability.
- Travel for site assessments, internal design meetings, construction review, and interfacing with authorities having jurisdiction. Anticipated travel is approximately 25%.

Given Amazon's global presence, 25% travel is required. This includes international travel to inspect and audit current and future data center sites. Collaboration with international teams is essential, and you may need to travel for workshops to develop schematic and detailed design documentation packages.

title: Non-Inventory Receiver
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer - centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

The Non-Inventory Receiver leads the day-to-day operations of the Non-Inventory (NIR) team, coordinating with L1 associates to ensure the efficient flow of non-inventory goods across the fulfilment centre. Reporting to the Site Procurement Manager (SPM), this role combines hands-on operational execution with team leadership, vendor coordination, and continuous improvement.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead and coordinate L1 Non-Inventory Receivers in daily task execution and prioritisation
• Train and onboard new NIR associates

• Ensure accuracy of non-inventory goods receiving and put-away performed by L1 associates
• Receive goods into Coupa system (data entry) and maintain accurate records
• Oversee shipping supplies cycle counts for accuracy
• Coordinate and schedule delivery times to align with site dock appointments
• Ensure yard staging area collections are booked and occurring, and maintain yard fullness below required thresholds
• Maintain housekeeping and safety standards (5S) across all non-inventory areas
• Monitor stock levels and flag any stock concerns proactively; chase the GPCS team, other sites, or vendors directly to mitigate potential stock-outs
• Respond to ad-hoc requests from site stakeholders for supplies, equipment, or services

title: Sr Product Manager (Tech), SCOT-BizOps AI
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) org builds systems to plan, procure, place and maintain optimal inventory within Amazon's network. Within SCOT, SCOT Connect team owns building a central AI infrastructure and data foundation that powers 10+ supply chain/CX metrics. SCOT Connect team is looking for a visionary Sr Product Manager – Tech to lead the next generation of AI-driven supply chain intelligence. SCOT Connect is the connective tissue of Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT) organization - the single interface where AI agents, data, and metrics come together to explain how Amazon's supply chain performs and where to act. Our charter: make SCOT's capabilities discoverable, its data trustworthy, and its insights actionable for humans and AI agents alike.

This role sits at the intersection of AI product development, large-scale data infrastructure, and supply chain measurement. You will own data and AI products that are reviewed at the Board of Directors and Stores leadership level that deliver insights for Amazon's supply chain organization. Your work directly impacts strategic decisions as your products identify anomalous trends, parse out defects in systems/processes across every step of planning and execution and eventually, ensure that Amazon is able to delight its customers with great CX by bringing inventory available close to customers. You own building the data foundation that makes it all possible and AI/Analytics applications that scale.

What Makes This Role Unique

You will work across SCOT organization to define the data backbone of Amazon's supply chain.  You will define the strategy for what data enters this foundation, how it is structured for AI consumption, and how teams across Amazon consume it.

You will ship AI products at production scale. Your portfolio includes building AI tools- MCPs, Knowledge Bases, Skills and Agentic frameworks - that reshape how traditional analytics products worked.

You will own metrics that Amazon's leadership uses to run the business. The team already owns 10+ metrics across three critical supply chain domains, and has plans to expand into other metrics to standardize within a centralized WW framework. These metrics are reviewed at Board, S-Team, QBR, and WBR cadences and are the primary lens through which Amazon evaluates supply chain health.

# What You Will Do

- Define and execute the product vision for SCOT level Data Foundation - drive a multi-year initiative to build canonical, AI-ready supply chain datasets that eliminate fragmented data pipelines and enable any SCOT team to get standardized insights without writing complex SQL across dozens of tables. Build the capability to quickly integrate new datasets and adapt to changes in Supply Chain systems
- Drive the AI product roadmap - from metric deep-divers, AI-generated callouts to agentic workflows that move from insight to automated action
- Own the federated metric architecture - lead the technical product strategy for how partner teams contribute marketplace-specific customizations to metric attribution models via an AI-enabled bridging framework, reducing development time from weeks to days
- Scale AI-powered tools across Amazon's supply chain - Extend MCP coverage for metrics, build domain-specific AI agents, and launch Skills packages that automate deep dives and insight generation
- Communicate with senior leaders - prepare strategic documents for VP/SVP audiences; align roadmaps with SCOT's strategic objectives and drive cross-organizational alignment across Retail, Operations, and functional SCOT teams

#What You Will Build With

You will work with a team of software engineers, data engineers, applied scientists, and BIEs. Your tech stack spans agentic AI infrastructure (MCP servers, AI Skills, knowledge bases), large-scale data pipelines (Spark/Cradle, Andes, Redshift), federated metric compute engines, and AI evaluation frameworks.

Key job responsibilities
- Work with internal customers to understand their use cases and their existing solutions. Drive requirements definition, UI design, feature development priority, and product adoption/effectiveness.
- Collaborate with your engineering and business teams to drive the product roadmaps.
- Define product strategy and vision, and own the product roadmap and related literature.
- Address bottlenecks, identify inefficiencies, anticipate and make tradeoffs; balance the business and customers’ needs versus technical constraints.
- Own production of business metrics for Availability data-products- detecting anomalies, deep long-term trends and insight generation.
- Lead technical product development for new strategic initiatives.
- Own Business Requirement Documents, User Stories, Use Cases, and Product Strategy documents.
- Evaluate technical solutions with alternatives and decompose significantly complex problems into concise and effective technical propositions.
- Partner with multiple tech and product teams across multiple locations with varying sets of priorities to ensure a timely delivery of the solution.

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

title: Senior Security AI Solution Architect, APJC Customer Security
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンウェブサービス（AWS）では、APJCのカスタマーセキュリティチームに加わるシニアセキュアAIソリューションアーキテクトを募集しています。これはビルダーの役割です。この地域の顧客はAIに急速に移行しており、自律エージェントにIDを与える方法、即時注入を防ぐ方法、AI開発ライフサイクルを管理する方法、規制当局が信頼するガバナンスの証拠を作成する方法など、これまで直面したことのない課題に関するガイダンスを求めています。あなたは彼らがそこにたどり着くのを助け、野心を検証された証明に変えるプロトタイプと概念実証を彼らの環境で実践的に構築する建築家です。多くの場合数日かかります。

あなたはフロンティアで活動しています。そこでは進むべき道はまだ決まっていません。顧客には明確な目標があります。リスク、規制、データレジデンシーの義務を管理しながら、エージェントAIを本番環境に導入することです。あなたの役割は、その方法を設計することです。確立されたパターンが存在しない新しいアプローチを作成し、各顧客のオペレーション状況と規制環境について判断を下すことです。技術的には自給自足です。コードを記述し、IaCでデプロイし、強化し、実際のデータに対してライブでデモンストレーションします。

深さだけが仕事ではありません-規模が仕事です。1人の顧客と一緒に解決する最も難しい問題は、この分野全体を高めるはずです。複雑で斬新なセキュアAIの課題を独自に深く掘り下げ、オリジナルの技術コンテンツ（リファレンスアーキテクチャ、作業コード、パターン、ワークショップ）を作成し、それを共有することで、1人の顧客で実証されたパターンをあらゆる分野で再利用できるものにします。あなたはAWSのサービスチーム（Bedrock、AgentCore、SageMaker）との関係を築いています。あなたは製品ロードマップを形作る分野の声であり、フィールドガイダンスを形作る製品の代弁者です。

セキュリティとガバナンスは、顧客が自信を持ってAIに「はい」と言える理由です。CISOに迅速かつ安全に行動するための枠組み、証拠、ツールを提供し、ガバナンスが成果を遅らせることはないとCIO/CTOに自信を与えます。あなたは、AWSがAIで安全に構築するのに最適な場所であることを証明しています。

Key job responsibilities
AWS AIサービス（Bedrock、AgentCore、SageMaker）、AI拡張開発ツール、IaC（CDK、Terraform）を使用して、顧客のサンドボックス環境で実用的なプロトタイプと概念実証を構築します。これにより、安全なAIコントロールが顧客のデータとリスクモデルに対して機能することが四半期ではなく数日で証明されます。
意思決定の妨げにならないように直接実装してください。エージェントのアイデンティティ、即時注入による防御、AI開発ライフサイクル、ガードレール、会話だけではできないことを検証する監査/証拠パターンなどです。
設計が現実に合わないように、実装中ずっと関与し続け、学んだことに基づいてアプローチをいつ修正すべきかを判断してください。

セキュリティ上の観点からBedrock、AgentCore、SageMakerのサービスチームとの関係を把握してください。あなたは出荷するものを形作るAPJCのフィールド要件の声であり、フィールドがアドバイスすることを形作る製品の声です。

機能のリクエストや直接のエンゲージメントを通じて顧客の声をフィードバックし、数時間で変化する脅威や規制の状況を常に把握できます。
サービスチームのロードマップを現場ですぐに使えるガイダンスに変換し、大規模にパッケージ化されていることを確認します。
リファレンスアーキテクチャ、作業コード、パターン、ブログ投稿、ワークショップなどのオリジナルの技術コンテンツを作成し、同業者や顧客に採用してもらい、1つの顧客獲得を再利用可能な地域のIPに変えます。
地域ベースのソリューションアーキテクトやより広いフィールドコミュニティなど、他の人を指導し、育成することで、地域全体でセキュアAIの技術的水準を高め、次の専門家を育成します。
コンテンツとイネーブルメントチームに実績のあるパターンを渡すので、あなたの立ち会いを必要とせずに現場にガイダンスが届きます。

A day in the life
朝は、スライドデッキではなく、お客様のサンドボックスから始めます。ある金融サービスの顧客が、Bedrockで代理アプリケーションを立ち上げたいと考えていますが、あなたが構築したIDと監査の統制により、CISOが必要とする正確な証拠が一夜にして得られました。コードを整理し、パターンをキャプチャして、2つのガードレールの設定に名前を付ける簡単な要約を用意して、彼らに自信を持って進めてもらいました。

午前中に、Bedrockで構築したいと考えていて、データレジデンシーとPIIの管理に関するガイダンスを必要としているメーカーに、セキュリティセールスパートナーやエリアアカウントチームに加わります。これはまったく新しい問題であり、確立されたパターンは存在しません。そこで、進むべき方向性を設計します。エージェントのアイデンティティとデータレジデンシーのアプローチをホワイトボードで示し、ビルダーチームが採用する非人間アイデンティティパターンのプロトタイプ作成に取り掛かります。

昼食後、真っ向から取り組んで構築し、実際にキーボードを使ってサンドボックスにデプロイし、強化します。その後、コーディングアシスタントのロールアウトに向けたプロンプトインジェクション防御について、お客様のプラットフォームチームと作業セッションを行います。

あなたは一日を締めくくり、自分を超えてスケーリングします。今週のFSIの成果を他の分野で再利用できるリファレンスアーキテクチャにまとめ、それをコンテンツチームに渡してワークショップにし、現場と記事を共有し、学んだことに基づいてAgentCoreチームに機能リクエストを提出します。同じように見える日は二日もありません。つまり、顧客が安全に加速できるように支援し、構築したものを地域全体が恩恵を受けるものに変えることです。

About the team
APJC Customer Securityは、地域の顧客が自信を持ってAWSでAIを採用できるよう支援します。セキュリティ、リスク、規制を確保することで、AIの運用を遅らせるのではなく、加速させることができます。私たちは、Secure AI（AWSをAIで安全に構築するのに最適な場所にする）とAI for Security（AIを使って顧客が身を守るのに役立つ）という2つのプログラムを組み合わせて運営しています。シニア・セキュア・AIソリューション・アーキテクトは、深い技術的専門知識をお客様が必要とするところに直接届けられます。新しい問題に対するアプローチを定義し、それを実際に証明してから、そのパターンをコンテンツチームと現場に渡して規模を拡大します。明確な開発経路、専門家の仲間コミュニティ、リーダーシップの直接的な可視性、業界で最も重要な分野の1つで技術的な方向性を決める自主性が得られます。

Basic qualifications

- 8年以上の特定の技術領域（ソフトウェア開発、クラウドコンピューティング、システムエンジニアリング、インフラストラクチャ、セキュリティ、ネットワーキング、データ＆アナリティクス等）における経験
- 3年以上のアプリケーションおよびインフラストラクチャの設計、構築、またはコンサルティングの経験
- 10年以上のソフトウェアまたはインターネット業界におけるIT開発もしくは導入・コンサルティングの経験
- クラウドセキュリティにおける経験及び知識
- 生成AIセキュリティにおける経験及び知識

Preferred qualifications

- 5年以上のインフラ、データベース、ネットワークいずれかのアーキテクチャ設計における実務経験
- クラウドアーキテクチャに関する知識

title: Art Director, Key Art Dev, GSS Creative Studio
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Prime Video brings world-class storytelling to global audiences through high-impact creative campaigns and experiences. GSS Creative Studio combines creative and brand expertise with operational excellence to deliver scalable, high-quality creative solutions across Prime Video business lines, channels and marketplaces.
Creative Studio is seeking a Sr. Art Director specializing in Key Art and Campaign Development. This is a hands-on creative role responsible for developing distinctive visual concepts that communicate the narrative, tone and audience proposition of entertainment and sports content.

Working within the broader strategy established by the Creative Director, the Sr. Art Director owns project-level visual direction from ideation through approved key art and campaign development. They guide Visual Designers, present creative recommendations and ensure the selected concept can extend effectively across campaign placements and production requirements.

The ideal candidate combines strong conceptual thinking with advanced expertise in image composition, typography, retouching and entertainment advertising. They can transform complex or ambiguous briefs into clear visual territories while maintaining a high creative and technical standard.

Key job responsibilities
   Lead project-level key art and campaign concept development from brief and ideation through approved visual direction.
·    Translate title narratives, campaign objectives, brand strategy and audience insights into distinctive visual territories.
·    Develop hands-on key art comps, concept presentations and campaign explorations.
·    Establish composition, imagery, typography, color and visual hierarchy for assigned creative.
·    Guide Visual Designers through creative exploration and development, providing clear direction and actionable feedback.
·    Own the creative integrity and quality of assigned key art through approval and downstream handoff.
·    Present concepts and creative recommendations to stakeholders, articulating the strategic and visual rationale behind the work.
·    Evaluate feedback, resolve creative ambiguity and recommend the strongest path forward.
·    Partner with the Creative Director on complex, high-profile or strategically sensitive creative decisions.
·    Consider talent, photography, licensing, brand and asset limitations during concept development.
·    Provide creative direction for photoshoots or image-development activities when required by the project.
·    Ensure selected key art can extend thoughtfully across digital, social, OOH, owned-and-operated and other campaign placements.
·    Prepare clear visual guidance and organized creative files for finishing, adaptation and production.
·    Explore approved creative technologies and AI-assisted workflows where they strengthen concept development or execution.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experience
- An online portfolio heavily focused on key art, entertainment advertising or campaign concept development.
- Experience leading creative development from concept through approved execution.
- Advanced proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and presentation tools.
- Advanced expertise in composition, photo manipulation, retouching, typography and visual storytelling.
- Experience providing creative direction and feedback to designers.
- Experience managing multiple complex creative projects and deadlines.
- Strong presentation, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experience
- Experience developing key art for film, television, streaming, sports or other entertainment properties.
- Experience working with talent imagery, unit photography, photoshoots and licensed assets.
- Experience extending key art into integrated 360-degree campaigns.
- Experience presenting creative concepts to senior stakeholders.
- Understanding of global campaign development and regional adaptation requirements.
- Familiarity with motion concepting and emerging creative technologies.

title: Automation Engineer Apprentice, TOL3 RME
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role:
The Automation Engineering Apprentice(ship) (AEA) will learn to focus on equipment troubleshooting and maintaining material handling equipment (MHE) such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply labeling systems, scales, HMI systems, and control cabinets. During on-the-job learning (OJL) you will work with complex high-performance manufacturing systems and will learn to analyze, troubleshoot, and repair systems to maintain process efficiency. The focus of this role is to learn the skills and abilities to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, assist in the installation, maintenance, and repair of the automated packaging and distribution equipment, ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard, and provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement.

Amazon AEA apprentices are engaged in the assembly and maintenance of complex machines, plants, and systems in the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering sector or in organizations which purchase and operate such mechatronic systems. Apprentices are paired with journey workers to carry out their work at various facilities, including high automation and robotics facilities in connection with service operations. They are expected to work based on technical documents and instructions and carry out their work in compliance with the relevant provisions and safety regulations.

The successful candidate is an effective communicator, works well in a team, and is self-motivated. They should have the ability to work collaboratively and coordinate their activities with upstream and downstream operations partners. In addition to developing your skills, you will be mentored by senior technicians to grow in your role.

What Do We Offer?
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

You will conduct preventative/corrective maintenance and basic troubleshooting of robotics and robotic work cells
You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all material handling equipment components
You will maintain and troubleshoot motors, photo eyes, relays, proximity sensors, solenoids, motor starters, tachs, etc.
You will assist with basic electronics/Programmable Logic Controllers troubleshooting
You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Mechatronics & Robotics Technician (MRT) experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High School diploma, or equivalent
- Knowledge of basic mathematics
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can commute to the specified work site
- Can commit to a 2-year onsite apprenticeship following a 12-week training period
- Can complete a 12-week training program at a designated training provider

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in the electrical field, or experience in the mechanical or controls field
- Experience with PLC (Programmable Logic Controller)-controlled automation and issue diagnosis in a continuous process or production environment
- Experience with robotics work cells and their control systems
- Experience with Ladder Logic and structure programming from Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Codesys PLCs (Programmable Logic Controllers)
- Experience with electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment
- Experience interpreting, modifying, and developing mechanical and electrical drawings
