title: Senior Sales Manager, Digital Native Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing millions of customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative digital native companies in the world — from category-defining consumer platforms to high-growth ISVs — as well as the largest global enterprises.
We are looking for a Senior Sales Manager to lead a small, highly talented team of Senior Strategic Account Managers responsible for three of AWS’s most strategic Digital Native accounts. These are relationships spanning large-scale infrastructure, data, media, and generative AI workloads, each with active enterprise agreements and complex, executive-level negotiations in flight.
Your responsibilities will include building and managing a highly talented sales team focused on driving revenue, adoption, and market penetration across this concentrated, high-value account set. The ideal candidate will possess a sales management background that enables them to lead senior enterprise account managers with engagements at the CxO level, manage a strategic sales pipeline across renewals and net-new workloads, and lead sales efforts that include teaming with AWS Solutions Architects, Specialists, Professional Services, and Partners within the largest AWS accounts. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to build and convey compelling value propositions — including AI/ML and generative AI — while working cross-organizationally to build consensus.

Key job responsibilities
Drive revenue, adoption, and market share for AWS across a portfolio of three strategic Digital Native accounts.

Lead, coach, and develop a team of Senior Strategic Account Managers, setting account strategy and holding the team accountable to quarterly and annual revenue and pipeline targets.

Develop and execute against a strategic account plan for each account, balancing large multi-year agreement renewals with net-new workload capture (Core and AI).

Own executive relationships at the CxO level and orchestrate senior AWS leadership engagement in support of major negotiations and account initiatives.

Maintain a robust, well-qualified sales pipeline with rigorous forecasting hygiene.

Lead and support complex contract and enterprise agreement negotiations alongside the extended deal team.

Team with Solutions Architects, Specialists, Professional Services, Partners, and ISVs to extend reach and accelerate adoption of AWS solutions.

Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and ensure a high bar for customer satisfaction.

Basic qualifications

- BA/BS degree
- 10–15 years of technology-related sales experience.
- 5–7 years of sales management experience, including leading enterprise or strategic account teams.
- Experience driving revenue and market share and consistently meeting or exceeding quarterly and annual revenue targets.
- Experience developing and executing against a strategic sales plan and maintaining a robust sales pipeline.
- Experience working with partners and ISVs to extend reach and drive adoption of solutions.
- Experience managing complex contract negotiations alongside a core sales organization.
- Must be able to travel (30%)

Preferred qualifications

- Direct field and management experience working with enterprise or digital native accounts.
- Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, data, and AI/ML or generative AI solutions and the ability to convey compelling value propositions to technical and executive audiences.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, an extensive customer network, and strong leadership skills.

title: Senior Manager PMT-ES, AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention
descriptionHtml:
AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention is seeking a Sr. Manager PMT-ES to lead a team of product managers focused on transforming how customers (humans and agents) adopt and transact with AWS. This role drives strategic initiatives that expand AWS's global reach and accessibility by increasing geographic payment coverage, diversifying payment methods, and reducing friction across customer touchpoints. The position requires balancing growth-oriented product innovation with operational excellence, overseeing initiatives that span from streamlining enterprise onboarding and payment experiences to pioneering next-generation capabilities like embedded checkout and AI-powered payment solutions. The leader will guide cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business impact through improved customer conversion, enhanced payment success rates, and optimized cash flow management, while building the foundation for future autonomous payment capabilities that meet customers wherever they are in their cloud journey.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Leadership

Define and execute the multi-year product strategy for global payment adoption and customer accessibility across AWS's expanding customer base
Partner with senior leadership across AWS Billing, Accounting, FinTech, Sales, and external financial institutions to align product roadmaps with business objectives
Establish product metrics and KPIs that balance customer adoption, payment success rates, and revenue optimization

Product Development & Execution

Lead a team of product managers responsible for the payments adoption portfolio spanning payment methods expansion, enterprise onboarding, and GenAI-powered tools
Prioritize and sequence initiatives across geographic payment coverage expansion, payment method diversification, and customer contact point optimization
Coordinate product launches across 33+ engineering teams spanning multiple organizations
Champion customer-centric solutions that reduce barriers to AWS adoption while maintaining security, compliance, and financial controls
Champion AI-driven development in the organization, including GenAI applications for payment lifecycle management

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with engineering leaders to balance technical architecture decisions with product requirements across Payments and Fraud Prevention teams
Partner with operations teams to ensure products are scalable and operationally excellent across payment processing, cash application, and collections
Collaborate with legal, compliance, and security teams to navigate regulatory requirements across global markets and emerging payment technologies
Coordinate with external partners including payment processors, financial institutions, real-time payment networks, and blockchain providers

Innovation & Risk Management

Identify emerging payment technologies (real-time payments, stablecoins, embedded checkout) and financing models that could benefit AWS customers
Drive automation and machine learning initiatives to improve payment success rates and operational scalability
Balance innovation velocity with the security, stability, and compliance requirements of financial systems serving millions of customers globally


About the team
Join a mission-critical organization of 500+ builders protecting billions in AWS revenue while enabling seamless customer experiences across global markets. Our team combines world-class engineering talent with product innovation to solve complex challenges at the intersection of payments, fraud prevention, and customer adoption—managing the complete financial lifecycle from processing payments in 14+ currencies to detecting sophisticated fraud patterns and delivering innovative financing solutions.

You'll lead product managers who ship systems processing millions of daily transactions, leverage ML for fraud detection, and create products that accelerate customer success and expand AWS's global reach. This is a team where your decisions directly impact AWS's financial health, customer trust, and competitive advantage, working alongside passionate builders who thrive on solving hard problems at unprecedented scale while maintaining the highest standards of security and operational excellence.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of people management experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
- Experience in people management
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience overseeing roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of successful technology products work from ideation through launch experience
- Experience in successful technology product work from ideation through launch
- Experience delivering technology products or services in a high growth environment
- Experience shaping business strategy for technical products or services for large enterprises or partners
- Experience with cloud native technologies

title: ［自衛官向け］サイトメンテナンスシニアテクニシャン,
descriptionHtml:
※現役自衛官の方を対象とした求人です。
※配属先は全国の物流拠点のいずれかとなります。別途面談を実施し、ご希望を伺ったうえで決定いたします。

Amazonの入荷・出荷のプロセスを行うFCには、世界最先端の自動化物流設備が導入されています。コンベア、ロボット、自動仕分けシステムなど、最新テクノロジーを活用し、商品の入出荷を効率的に行っています。このような先進的な環境で、次世代の物流技術に携わることができます。
　
RME（Reliability and Maintenance Engineering）部門は、日々物流設備の保全と保守、改善を行い、お客様に満足いただけるように努めております。 今回、RME部門が募集する職種はFCに導入されている物流設備の保全と保守、および設備の安全性や生産性を向上させるための改善を担当いただく「サイトメンテナンスシニアテクニシャン」というポジションになります。
　
本ポジションは物流設備の保全経験者だけでなく、異業界・異職種からのキャリアチェンジをお考えの方も広く募集しています。これまでのエンジニアとしての経験を活かしながら、次のステージへと成長できる環境をご用意しております。入社後は体系的な教育プログラムに加え、豊富な経験を持つ先輩社員によるさぽーとにより、確かな技術力と自信を着実に身につけていただけます。
　
RMEにて技術力と現場感を身に着けることで将来的なキャリア選択肢は大きく広がります。マネジメント職や技術スペシャリストへのキャリアアップはもちろん、社内公募制度を通じて設備導入、設計、開発など、幅広いフィールドでの活躍も可能です。

【More Information】
■メンテナンス部門について
　・メンテナンスエンジニア特設サイト
　・社員インタビュー/堺FC勤務の社員T.S.さん
　・社員インタビュー/堺FC勤務の社員E.M.さん
■勤務地について
　・フルフィルメントセンター (FC)
　
Amazon は多様かつインクルーシブな職場づくりを目指しています。Amazonは男女雇用機会均等法を順守しています。人種、 出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他の属性によって差別することなく、平等に採用選考の機会を提供しています。障がいをお持ちの方は、以下をご覧ください。https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp
オペレーション部門のDEIの取り組み

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
【具体的な業務内容】
下記業務をチームで対応いただきます。
■60%：日常点検・異常対応…稼働監視/巡回による設備点検/異常対応、故障復旧/オーバーホール、部品修繕
■20%：メンテナンス業務…予防保全/定期保全/状態保全/事後保全
■10%：安全対策…設備・作業環境の安全対策/5S活動
■5%：カイゼン活動…機械、電気、制御（PLC）と広い範囲でカイゼンや改造を実施
■5%：その他…メンテナンス計画/デザインレビュー
　
【取り扱う設備の一例（FCによって異なる）】
■Amazon Robotics（商品棚を持ち上げて移動させるロボット）
■荷合わせシステム（同じお客様が注文された商品を一つにまとめる設備）
■パッキング設備（荷合わせした商品をまとめて梱包する設備）
■仕分け設備（宛先ラベルの印刷と貼り付けを行い、配送方面毎に仕分けを行う設備）

A day in the life
【教育・研修】
・入社後は、体系化された教育プログラムに沿って、安全ルール、保全作業、専門的な技術習得（機械・電気・制御）を進めていただきます。同時に所属拠点ではOJTを通して実務を習得いただきます。まずは物流設備の軽微なエラー対応や保全・保守の補佐業務を担当いただき、バディー制度により先輩社員がサポートをいたしますので、不明点の確認や相談がしやすい環境となります。その後は今までのキャリアの中で培ってきたスキルを応用し、改善や安全対策、効率化施策を手掛けることで幅広い領域で活かしていただくことができます。
　
【働き方】
本ポジションは、シフト勤務になり「3交代・早番専属・夜勤専属」のシフトパターンがあります。
シフトパターンは希望を考慮の上、決定させていただきますが、将来的なシフト勤務形態の変更の可能性もございます。
＜シフト例＞※シフトは拠点によって異なります。
　・3交代 　6:00-15:00, 14:30-23:30, 23:00-8:00
シフトは1か月以上前に事前に周知される為、休暇の計画が立てやすく、チームで調整することで休暇が取得しやすい環境です。
退勤時間には次の班が出勤し引継ぎを行う為、残業時間が少なく、急な呼び出しも発生しません。
公共交通機関が運行しない時間帯でも交代勤務に出社できるようお願いいたします。
（自家用車・自転車は可（入社前に要申請・許可制）、バイク・タクシーは不可）

Basic qualifications

- 機械や電気機器の保全や保守、または生産技術・設備導入や立ち上げを1年以上ご経験された方
- PCを使用した作業のご経験のある方。（エクセル、ワード、Outlook）
- ビジネスレベルの日本語力（メールの読み書き、報告、連絡、相談ができる）

Preferred qualifications

- 物流設備の保守保全、もしくはフィールドエンジニアの経験
- 機械部品の取扱経験・知識（モーター・エアシリンダー・動力伝達機構・バルブなど）
- 電気部品の取扱経験・知識（インバーター・光学センサー・BCR・温度センサーなど）
- 制御機器の取扱経験・知識（PLC・サーボアンプ・タッチパネル・調節計など）
- 機械工学、もしくは電気工学の基礎知識 （工業高校または専門学校卒業程度）
- 労働安全衛生基礎知識　（製造工場・生産設備での安全知識）
- 英語でのコミュニケーション能力
- オーナーシップ：自ら課題を見つけ、責任を持って解決できる。
- 探究心と向上心：いままで経験がない業務においても新しい知識を学ぶことに意欲的で、何事にも前向きに取組むことができる。
- チームワーク：リスペクトを持ってメンバーと協働でき、報連相ができる。
- 機敏性と柔軟性：変化する状況や環境に機敏、且つ柔軟に対応できる。
- インクルーシブなカルチャーへの貢献や多様性に富んだグループで働くことに対して前向きであること。

title: Operations Supervisor
descriptionHtml:
Il team Operations è il cuore pulsante di Amazon ed è grazie al suo operato impeccabile che riusciamo a elaborare e spedire gli ordini ai nostri clienti in tempi record. Nel ruolo di Operations Lead/Supervisor avrai l’opportunità di toccare con mano l’interazione tra le diverse componenti delle nostre attività operative, contribuendo in prima persona a garantirne un funzionamento efficiente.
Sarai il punto di riferimento per i colleghi durante il turno di lavoro e li aiuterai a seguire i processi introdotti dai manager. Il ruolo prevede una forte componente pratica: avrai la possibilità di acquisire esperienza nell’utilizzo di strumenti e sistemi da cui dipende il successo della nostra attività.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è CCNL Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizioni. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.

Key job responsibilities
- Misurare e monitorare i flussi di lavoro e le performance del sito, nonché fornire rilevanti informazioni ai manager di prima linea per garantire l’eccellenza operativa in tutti i turni.
- Supportare e formare il personale affinché assicuri un servizio d’eccellenza e supervisionarlo nello svolgimento delle mansioni quotidiane.
- Supportare l’Area/Shift Manager nell’ambito di progetti per migliorare i processi, creare un ambiente di lavoro sicuro e aumentare il coinvolgimento del personale.
- Collaborare con altri reparti per individuare soluzioni tese a risolvere problematiche frequenti o soddisfare le necessità, laddove la produttività è cruciale.
- Analizzare i dati per identificare piani volti all’ottimizzazione della sicurezza, qualità e produttività.

A day in the life
Il ruolo di Operations Lead/Supervisor prevede il supporto all'Area/Shift Manager nella gestione operativa del turno. Le responsabilità principali includono: conduzione delle riunioni di inizio turno, supervisione delle procedure di sicurezza e qualità, monitoraggio delle priorità giornaliere e segnalazione di criticità ai manager. In alcuni turni, sarà la figura senior di riferimento con autonomia decisionale. Il ruolo comprende anche il supporto nella pianificazione dei turni per garantire un'adeguata copertura del personale nei periodi di picco.

About the team


Basic qualifications

- Conoscenza avanzata dell’italiano, scritto e parlato.
- Vasta esperienza nell’analisi dei dati in un contesto professionale e nell’utilizzo di tali indicatori per l’individuazione di problemi.
- Buona padronanza del pacchetto MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) in contesti di uso professionale

- Esperienza in un contesto operativo, ad esempio di tipo logistico, vendita al dettaglio, settore alberghiero o hospitality, o customer service.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Prime is a core pillar of Amazon’s consumer businesses, serving over 200 million members worldwide across 26+ countries. Prime aspires to be the world’s most engaging, satisfying, and loved membership program – delivering profitable growth by improving the Amazon experience through fast shipping, exclusive deals, digital entertainment, and an ever-expanding set of benefits.

The Amazon Prime UX Design team is at the heart of the Prime membership, innovating and designing on behalf of our customers. We are relentlessly focused on improving the membership experience to delight customers around the globe. Prime UX researchers and designers work with global Product, Marketing, Branding, Data Science, and Tech team partners, to deliver compelling customer experiences for Amazon worldwide (WW).

The WW Prime Member Growth team is on a mission to bring the value of Prime to hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. We're looking for a Product Designer to join our growing team and shape the end-to-end Prime membership experience — from how customers discover and understand Prime's value to how they engage with it every day. You approach your craft with an AI-native mindset, actively integrating AI tools and capabilities into your research, ideation, and delivery process to move faster and raise the quality of your output. You think first from the customer's perspective, use research and data to influence your designs, set relentlessly high standards for yourself, and deliver best-in-class customer experiences. descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Have you wanted an opportunity to develop the core wireless and networking for an advanced global telecom service spanning both space and terrestrial networks? Have you wondered what it takes to solve a multi-dimensional routing problem at global scale? Amazon Leo's UMAC team will design, implement and operate Leo's network control plane for the network MAC layer. This service will enable a high throughput telecom service using a system of LEO satellites, customer terminals, gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial network infrastructure that connect into public and private networks. For this role, you will:

- Take responsibility for designing and delivering a modern, flexible, scalable, high throughput, low latency network architecture.
- Implement Routing and Forwarding, Traffic Engineering, and SDN technologies to deliver the best-in-class broadband network services for our customers.
- Implement highly-available software that will drive networking control plane operation on physical and remote nodes.
- Define and automate processes used for software development, implementation, testing, and maintenance.
- Provide operational excellence for control plane services, to including enabling tools and definition/refinement of operational processes.
- Developing routing control plane software for network nodes in C and Rust.

A day in the life
This is an opportunity to be at the heart of the design, building and operation of a massive satellite constellation and terrestrial network. We interact with the satellite ground control services, the customer engagement systems and monitoring services to constantly fine-tune our network and deliver a high quality service to our customers. You will be responsible to build the best network for our customers.

About the team
The UMAC team is building the control plane driving the Leo Network. Innovation is in our DNA and we tackle the problems presented by a dynamic network at global scale. It is our responsibility to ensure that the network works and our customer has a one-of-a-kind experience using our service.

Our team will design, implement and operate the control plane that provides a high throughput telecom service comprised of Low Earth Orbit satellites, customer terminals, gateways, Cloud services and terrestrial network infrastructure that connects into public and private networks.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Physical Requirements:
• Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
• Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
• Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
• Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
• Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.


Key job responsibilities
• Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
• Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
• Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
• Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
• Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
• Technical writing to support change management program
• Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
• On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
• Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
• Role may support more than one location/site.


A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- Experience in relevant work
- Can bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
- Can use hands to manipulate small wires and objects
- Can walk on job sites in uneven terrain
- Can work at heights and from ladders
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical experience
- Ability to work on a flexible schedule including days, nights, and/or weekends.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in data center engineering
- Can perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired
- Experience working in a data center or mission critical facility (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.)

descriptionHtml:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

AWS includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

The Security Assurance Services team, a part of Amazon Web Services, leverages the expertise and ingenuity of our builders to establish scalable security solutions for both internal and external customers that drive business outcomes. Our goal of securing the world’s workloads and building a brighter future for humanity requires us to focus on reliable delivery of bar raising security outcomes and investment in security mechanisms and automation on behalf of our customers.

The AWS Security Assurance Services team works with our largest enterprise customers to operationalize the shared responsibility model as they migrate to the cloud. Are you a Governance, Risk, and Compliance leader who can address the challenges of migrating systems and workloads to the cloud? Are you skilled at helping executives address their enterprise risk management requirements using highly scalable computing architectures?

The AWS Security Assurance Service team, within AWS Support, is seeking a talented Assurance Solution Architect to help the expansion of the Security Assurance practice and educate our customers on how our product-led, people-powered services helps operate their business securely on AWS while also demonstrating assurance that compliance objectives can be achieved. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute at the intersection of cloud, cyber security, and compliance. You will have the opportunity to work with multiple lines of business, and learn from (and contribute to) a variety of security and compliance use cases.

This is a customer facing role where success is measured by helping enable our customers in moving their workloads and regulated data into the cloud by addressing specific risk, regulatory, and compliance requirements. We are looking for an innovative security/compliance professional who has the ability to handle a wide range of compliance requirements, is willing to dive in to the details, can translate those requirements into scalable solutions, and is able to communicate at all levels within an organization.

We are looking for an innovative security/compliance professional who has the ability to handle a wide range of compliance requirements, is willing to dive in to the details, can translate those requirements into scalable solutions, and is able to communicate at all levels within an organization.


Key job responsibilities
• Expertise – Delivers in teams that include Amazonians, partners, and customers to enhance security assurance and compliance programs
• Solutions – Work with a team to define innovative compliance and risk management approaches to customers that help the customer understand how to move sensitive workloads onto the cloud faster.
• Delivery – Engagements will require working to resolve security assurance questions and to understand how to manage risk and achieve compliance while operating in the AWS Cloud through deep dive discussions, strategic presentations/recommendations, and hands on demonstrations of automating compliance in the AWS environment.
• Insights – Work with AWS engineering, support and business teams to convey partner and customer feedback as input to AWS technology roadmaps.
• Ability to travel to customer sites as needed.


About the team
AWS Security Assurance Services LLC, a PCI-QSAC (Payment Card Industry-Qualified Security Assessor company) and HITRUST External Assessor Firm, is a team of industry certified assessors, helping our customers achieve, maintain, and automate compliance in the cloud by tying together applicable audit standards to AWS service specific features and functionality. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Knowledge of AWS services
- 4+ years experience advising customers on architectures meeting industry standards such as PCI DSS, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and NIST frameworks
- US government security clearance of secret or above

Preferred qualifications

- Cloud Technology Certification (such as Solutions Architecture, Cloud Security Professional or Cloud DevOps Engineering), or CASP+ (CompTIA Advanced Security Practitioner) or CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional) or Cloud+ or CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)
- Experience in performing security assessments and information system audits of network, operating systems, application security, as well as auditing IT processes
- Clear understanding of Agile, CI/CD, DevOps approach and how they impact risk management and compliance
- Fluency with generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools and applying responsible AI practices to augment productivity and quality

title: Principal Product Manager Technical, External Services, Amazon Connect
descriptionHtml:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Amazon Connect is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

We have a rapidly growing customer base and an exciting charter in front of us that includes solving highly complex engineering and algorithmic problems while designing beautiful, simple user experiences. We are looking for a passionate, talented, and experienced Principal Product Manager - Technical, External Services to join us to lead the strategy and roadmap for communication channels in Amazon Connect. The position is a rare opportunity to join a fast-growing business and help shape the technology and product as we grow. You will play a crucial role in developing the next generation of AWS application services and have the opportunity to design and deliver high-scale, resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus. This team is a great fit for you if:


1. You enjoy working with a fun team that prides itself on a great work environment with an inclusive group of people that are working together towards a common goal.

2. You are sensitive to customer needs and interested in working on a service that will be used, directly and indirectly, by millions of customers and has a meaningful impact to their functions and interactions.

3. You'd like to be directly responsible for solving real customer problems.

4. You are a passionate learner and are motivated to take on new challenges.

5. You want to have fun, surround yourself with a highly talented team that likes to solve complex problems, but also enjoys work-life balance.

Our team is focused on building and scaling externally facing services that help businesses of all sizes succeed. We operate with a strong sense of ownership and a commitment to delivering products that customers trust and rely on. We value collaboration, creative problem-solving, and a willingness to tackle hard questions. As we continue to grow, you will play a central role in shaping our product strategy and raising the bar for the services we deliver. If you are excited about working at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and customer impact, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
Define and own the multi-year product vision and strategy for one or more RTC product areas (e.g., agentic voice foundations, multimodal communications, turnkey RTC apps, or AI-powered voice/video agents), influencing the direction of a business with $700M+ in annual revenue
Set the long-term technical and product direction by authoring PRFAQs, strategy documents, and 3-year vision narratives that align engineering, design, and senior leadership (L8+/VP) around a shared north star
Identify and drive new-to-world opportunities that expand Amazon Connect's addressable market beyond the traditional contact center (e.g., IT service management, healthcare, recruiting)
Make high-judgment trade-off decisions across competing priorities, customer commitments, and technical investments — operating as the named product decision-maker for your domain
Drive cross-organizational alignment across multiple Amazon Connect product teams, ensuring RTC primitives are composable and reusable across the Connect portfolio
Represent the product externally with strategic enterprise customers (e.g., JPMC, Intuit, Telstra, CalSAWS), translating customer needs into product strategy and unblocking multi-million dollar migrations
Establish mechanisms and frameworks (e.g., quarterly business reviews, OKRs, product tenets) that raise the bar for how the team plans, prioritizes, and measures success
Mentor and develop Senior PMTs on the team, raising the product management bar across the organization
Influence without authority across engineering, science, design, GTM, and finance teams to drive alignment on complex, ambiguous, multi-team initiatives

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing customer adoption metrics and preparing a decision narrative for leadership on a proposed service expansion. By midday, you are in a design review with engineering, working through trade-offs on a new feature that addresses a recurring pain point across enterprise customers. In the afternoon, you connect with partner teams to align roadmap priorities, then close out by refining a pricing model or drafting a technical white paper that will guide customer-facing conversations.

title: HR Partner, Amazon Operations
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The Partner, PXT role offers an exceptional opportunity to build your career in human resources, focusing on employee experience, engagement, leadership development, and PXT operational excellence. 

As a Partner, PXT within the One PXT team, you will support PXT operations through consistent standard work execution, relationship-building, and timely issue resolution. With a visible presence across site(s) operations, you'll foster team culture, support engagement, and coach leaders on PXT practices. You'll create positive employee experiences while building your skills in navigating increasingly complex issues and influencing without authority. Success in this role comes from building strong partnerships, demonstrating sound judgment, and maintaining a customer-centric approach. You'll learn to use data-driven insights and PXT technologies to enhance employee experience while developing core capabilities that will serve as the foundation for your career growth. This role is also a learning ground—new PXT Partners are encouraged to ask questions, seek feedback, and treat every experience as a development opportunity. 

You will be expected to work onsite(s) at an Amazon facility, with mobility requirements to support multiple site(s)s within the assigned campus as needed. 

Key job responsibilities
Support a positive employee experience by executing key programs, reinforcing workplace standards, and partnering with PXT and Operations to create a culture where employees feel valued, heard, and supported. 

Execute standard work with consistent quality and timeliness, meeting established service level agreements (SLAs) and maintaining accurate documentation of HR processes and employee interactions. 

Provide frontline employee support by responding to inquiries, addressing concerns, and ensuring appropriate resolution or escalation of employee matters. Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism. 

Assist in running and monitoring feedback channels such as roundtables, floor walks, and employee engagement activities. Support issue tracking and follow-up, partnering with senior PXT team members to drive resolutions and improvements in employee experience. 

Coach frontline leaders on behaviors that impact engagement and retention. Reinforce expectations and guide leaders in selecting and effectively utilizing available tools to improve team communication, recognition, and performance conversations. 

Support managers in performance management by coaching on setting clear expectations, delivering timely feedback, and documenting performance conversations. Help managers address root causes of performance issues and reinforce consistent use of PXT tools and processes. 

Assist with internal investigations, including gathering facts, reviewing documentation, and understanding root cause analysis. Learn from senior PXT partners how to uphold fairness, confidentiality, and compliance throughout the process. 

Support the execution of site(s)-level engagement, communication, and culture-building initiatives. Coordinate logistics, gather feedback, and monitor effectiveness. 

Learn to track and summarize PXT-related data (e.g., attrition/attendance trends, hiring data, employee sentiment). Help prepare insights for site(s) reviews or team discussions. 

Promote the use of self-service tools to resolve routine employee and manager questions. Help identify recurring gaps and escalate opportunities to improve tool usability or adoption. 



A day in the life
A typical day involves balancing standard work execution with responsive employee support. You'll maintain consistent presence on the operations floor, engaging directly with hourly employees and partnering with leaders to address concerns and drive engagement initiatives. Operating under the guidance of senior team members, you'll execute core HR processes while ensuring quality service delivery. 

Through data tools and HR technologies, you'll assist in tracking metrics and identifying trends, while developing your ability to build trust through personal interaction. You'll support employee engagement activities, help coordinate feedback channels, and assist in coaching and development of others. When complex issues arise, you'll seek guidance from senior team members, learning to navigate challenging situations while developing sound judgment. 

Success in this role comes from maintaining organized routines, demonstrating strong follow-through, and building effective partnerships with both the PXT team and Ops Partners. This role requires excellent organizational skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same. 

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field
- Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English and Local language
- Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., creating documents in Word, using basic spreadsheet functions in Excel, managing calendars/emails in Outlook).
- Ability to maintain confidentiality in handling sensitive information
- Experience communicating effectively with diverse audiences (e.g., explaining processes, addressing concerns, providing technical guidance)

Preferred qualifications

- Degree in HR, Management, Business, Labor Relations, Psychology, or a related field
- Experience in customer service or people-facing roles, demonstrating effective verbal and written communication skills
- Demonstrated ability to analyze information, solve problems, and make data-driven decisions
- Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel (e.g., ability to use pivot tables, v-lookups, and formulas)
- Proficiency in using AI-powered tools, HR analytics platforms, and emerging technologies to derive insights and drive process improvements
- Ability to effectively train, guide, and support others in the use of various HR technologies and digital platforms, with a focus on increasing user adoption and enhancing end-user experience
- Strong organizational skills with proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver results in fast-paced, dynamic environments
- Experience building partnerships and collaborating effectively across teams, demonstrating adaptability and autonomy
- Ability to exercise sound judgement and navigate ambiguous situations with limited direction
- Basic understanding of HR processes and policies
- Demonstrated problem-solving skills and resourcefulness

title: Systems Development Engineer, Enterprise Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Enterprise Engineering Unified Communications team builds high-quality voice and video communication solutions at global scale for Amazonians around the world. Our services support every part of the business, every day: corporate offices, customer service teams, fulfillment centers, our developer community and more.

We're looking for a motivated Systems Development Engineer to take telecommunications to the next level. You'll need strong coding skills, solid knowledge of software development best practices, and deep expertise in Linux operating systems and networking.

In this role, you'll help architect, design, support and improve our AWS-based telecommunications infrastructure. You'll make our systems self-healing and create self-service tools so Amazonians can manage their own telecom resources. Using AWS services, DevOps practices and mature CI/CD processes, you'll help build a cloud-scale telephony system. It's a chance to be creative in a space that hasn't seen real innovation in decades.

- Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)

title: Area Manager, Amazon Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.



Key job responsibilities
- Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
- Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
- Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices

A day in the life
You’ll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You’ll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation. A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. You’ll also be a role model and mentor to new managers.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree, or Associate's degree or above
- Experience in people management
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including peers and leadership
- Relevant experience in using data or anecdotal evidence to influence business decisions
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English and local language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a logistics/operations environment
- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we’d love to hear from you.
- Experience working with Lean, Six Sigma and Kaizen techniques
- Relevant experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment

title: Sr. Mfg Eng; Process Quality, Hardware Engineering Services - Manufacturing
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services’ Hardware Engineering team is looking for experienced professionals to help build the world’s premier cloud computing platform. We are looking for Manufacturing Engineers who are capable of operating in a fast paced, ever changing, multi-platform international manufacturing and production environment. Our Process Quality team works closely with our ODMs, CMs, internal AWS hardware and software development teams, and with upstream component vendors to scale up manufacturing processes and ensure we can achieve our throughput and quality targets. This role requires the engineer to be a technical contact and take on full ownership of the manufacturing launch and resolution of process issues. You will be the driver in getting production scaled across a global network. You will own PFMEAs, Control Plans and process flows from startup through the end of life of the product.


Key job responsibilities
Scale up manufacturing on new products across a global network.

Lead and oversee quality control processes across Contract Manufacturers (CM), Original Design Manufacturers (ODM), and component vendors

Deliver hands-on technical support during new product introductions and launches

Investigate and resolve customer escalations through comprehensive root cause analysis



Support global operations through regular domestic and international travel (25-50% of time)

Basic qualifications

title: Connectivity and Fiber Material Supply Chain Management, Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 11, 2026


Today, Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, low cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. The AWS Cloud infrastructure is built around Regions and Availability Zones. AWS Regions provide multiple, physically separated and isolated Availability Zones connected with low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant networking. The connectivity and fiber materials that go into those connections decide how fast and how reliably we build. Would you like to join the team that sources and qualifies the materials behind that low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant network?
Amazon Web Services is looking for a highly motivated, technically savvy Material Supply Chain Manager to develop and scale the connectivity and fiber material supply behind one of the world's largest and most complex networks. You own the strategy for a material category as a business, and you carry the commercial and technical relationship with the suppliers in that category. You define the sourcing strategy, lead the negotiations, and secure the supply we need to hit tight build schedules across regions.
You work in a space where the business problem, the domain strategy, and the technical solution are often undefined, and you bring clarity and deliver independently. You lead the commercial engagements that drive the strategy, including originating and negotiating new contract structures with suppliers rather than executing terms someone else set. You partner with legal and finance to define the financial and legal guardrails for a deal, then assess contract terms against those guardrails on your own judgment. You shape the roadmap for next generation fiber and connectors, and you qualify those materials with engineering so we build faster and at lower cost.
Your scope reaches across orgs and geographies. You influence the vendors, legal, finance, design engineering, and program teams who own infrastructure delivery, and you drive strategic decisions that affect build plans in multiple regions. You translate deployment demand into a supply plan, remove single source risks, and bring new suppliers online to protect our schedules and cost targets. You write the narratives that carry these decisions, and you present them to senior managers and directors.
You will be part of a creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most interesting and challenging problems in connectivity and fiber materials. Our networks lead the industry in capacity and cost effectiveness, and the materials strategy behind them keeps that lead. You will stay at the forefront of the material development industry and deliver the most innovative material solutions to our programs.
You will succeed in this role if you enjoy owning a category end to end, moving between a supplier negotiation and a technical qualification review in the same day, and making decisions with incomplete data under real schedule pressure. You set the strategy, then drive it to results. This role requires travel of 25 - 50%


Key job responsibilities

You own the supply chain strategy for a defined connectivity and fiber material category and carry the commercial relationship with the suppliers in that category. You build the demand forecast and supply plan that keeps programs on schedule, translating deployment demand into a clear view of what materials we need, when, and in what volume across regions. You define the strategy and execute it, usually within broader guidance. You originate and negotiate new contract structures, pricing, capacity commitments, and supply terms, then manage supplier performance against those terms. You partner with legal and finance to set acceptable financial and legal guardrails, and you assess contract terms against those guardrails independently. You lead the qualification of new suppliers and new materials with engineering. You identify supply risks early, build mitigation plans, and report category health to senior managers and directors through clear narratives and metrics. You drive cost reduction and dual sourcing initiatives that improve resilience across the network, and you mentor others on the team.


About the team
Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development - Fiber Deployment plans, manages, and delivers the physical fiber network that connects AWS data centers. The high-volume metro team delivers the fiber that brings new AWS capacity online across our busiest metro markets. You will work alongside construction vendors, engineers, and the internal customers who depend on that capacity, building large-scale fiber networks on time and to a high quality bar. Our focus for the coming years is scaling delivery without losing that quality, and this role is central to it. New teammates reach independent project ownership quickly, supported by runbooks and mentorship.

- Experience building demand forecasts and supply plans that support operational or deployment schedules
- Experience originating and negotiating supply agreements and contract structures, and managing supplier performance
- Experience defining and executing a category or sourcing strategy across multiple teams or geographies
- Experience with dual sourcing and supply risk mitigation across global suppliers
- Experience writing narratives and presenting strategy and decisions to senior managers and directors
- Experience working with legal and finance partners on contract terms, and with engineering, program management, and operations partners on delivery

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of experience sourcing connectivity or fiber materials, ideally fiber optic cable, connectors, or telecom hardware
- Experience building demand and supply forecasts for large scale or multi region programs
- Experience qualifying new suppliers or new materials in partnership with an engineering team
- Experience owning a category as a business, including cost, risk, and roadmap decisions across orgs
- Experience managing supply for large scale infrastructure or data center construction programs
- MBA or a master's degree in a related field

title: Security Engineer II, AWS Vulnerability Managment
descriptionHtml:
Vulnerabilities are now being discovered at machine speed, and the teams that protect customers need to respond just as fast. As a Security Engineer on the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Vulnerability Management team, you will help define how we assess, triage, and remediate security risks across AWS. You will partner with engineers and service teams to identify root causes, drive scalable fixes, and accelerate our response times so that high-risk issues are resolved before adversaries can take advantage of them.

This is a compelling time to join: AI is reshaping both how vulnerabilities surface and how we can address them, and our team is investing in new AI-driven and automation-first approaches to close findings at the root cause level. If you are a self-starter who thinks in terms of solving problems at machine speed and thrives on cross-team collaboration, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Assess and triage vulnerability disclosures and threat intelligence, authoring clear risk statements and remediation guidance that inform decision-making across AWS service teams.
- Own and coordinate large-scale remediation campaigns, tracking progress and reporting outcomes to security leadership while driving root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.
- Partner with builder teams across AWS to design pragmatic, maintainable security controls that reduce risk at scale without slowing innovation.
- Apply AI and automation to accelerate vulnerability assessment, remediation, and mitigation workflows, continuously improving the team's speed and consistency.
- Mentor fellow security engineers through peer reviews and knowledge sharing, raising the quality bar for the team's processes and deliverables.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing newly disclosed vulnerabilities, assessing their severity, and determining which AWS services are affected. From there you could shift into a working session with a service team to design a remediation path, then spend time building or tuning automation that helps the broader team close similar findings faster. You will balance focused, independent analysis with collaborative discussions, syncing with software developers, technical program managers, and security peers to keep remediation campaigns on track and share what you have learned.

The AWS Vulnerability Management team sits within Amazon Security and is responsible for identifying, assessing, and driving the resolution of security vulnerabilities across AWS. Our mission is to keep customers protected by closing high-risk findings quickly and eliminating the root causes that allow them to occur. title: Technical Program Manager III (TPM), Vendor EDI/API Integration — Mexico & Brazil, SCOT - Supplier Electronic Integration team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Global Supplier Electronic integration team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM III) to lead EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) and API (Application Programming Interface) integrations with Amazon’s external suppliers across Mexico and Brazil. The Supplier Electronic integration team powers the electronic integration flywheel behind the Amazon Retail Supply Chain, connecting suppliers to Amazon through automated data exchange.

In this role you will own several supplier integration projects in parallel and see each one through from first conversation to successful go-live. You will sit alongside the MX business teams and act as the bridge between two worlds: you translate business requirements and process needs into the right technical implementation, and you translate technical realities back into terms the business and the supplier understand. You will guide supplier SMEs and their IT teams through every aspect of our integration process, remove technical and process blockers, and drive excellence in data usage for the benefit of both the supplier and Amazon.

This is a role built for independence and collaboration at the same time. After an initial ramp-up period with our globally distributed team, you will be expected to be as self-sufficient as possible — making both the technical judgment calls and the strategic/tactical decisions needed to keep integrations moving. Beyond running projects, you will be on the pulse of the Mexico and Brazil business, building the strategy for how we make more vendor integrations happen: what makes it attractive for suppliers to integrate, which repetitive roadblocks to eliminate, and how EDI/API automation directly advances each country’s business goals when applied to a specific vendor’s situation.

Because this program is still early-stage in-region, you will get to pioneer with a business-development mindset — help the Mexico and Brazil business teams shaping the pitch to suppliers, codifying the recipe for a “perfect integration,” and continuously scaling the number of integrations that can be run in parallel. You will contribute to our documentation and AI-assisted tooling, feed ideas into our org’s improvement pipeline and feature roadmap, and be the voice of the MX/BR supplier back to our central product and tech teams.

The ideal candidate has a genuine technical background — enough to ramp up quickly on our systems, ask the right technical questions, judge trade-offs, and even build quick tooling for themselves — combined with the program-management discipline to run multiple projects cleanly, the business acumen to know why an integration matters to the country, and the communication skills to operate across languages and cultures. You are fluent in English and Spanish; Portuguese is a plus.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the lifecycle of a complex, cross-functional integration program spanning the Mexico and Brazil geographies. Manage multiple supplier EDI/API integrations in parallel — from concept and business-requirements gathering through technical implementation to successful go-live — with tactical execution and regional strategy ownership.

- Be the bridge between business and technology. Translate country and vendor business requirements into the right technical implementation, and translate technical realities back into business terms for suppliers and internal stakeholders. Deliver best-in-class, pro-active integration consultancy grounded in deep knowledge of our EDI/API solutions and the supplier's process and system blockers.

- Build and leverage strong relationships with external suppliers and 3rd party providers (including their SMEs, IT teams, and external service providers) and internal stakeholders to attract and grow adoption of our integration solutions.

- Own the region’s integration strategy. Stay on the pulse of the MX and BR business, understand how EDI/API automation advances each country’s goals, and build the strategy to drive more vendor integrations — making it more attractive for suppliers to integrate, evaluating and measuring the benefits for both Amazon and suppliers.

- Remove repetitive roadblocks and force-multiply. Identify recurring blockers across integrations, streamline or eliminate them, and codify the recipe for the “perfect integration and automation change management” so results scale beyond what one project-at-a-time allows.

- Operate with technical judgment and independence. After ramp-up, make sound technical and strategic/tactical decisions with limited guidance; understand our systems’ architecture, limitations, and the reasons behind design choices well enough to drive the right solution and mitigate the consequences of poor technology decisions.

- Contribute to documentation, AI solutions, and the product pipeline. Build and improve our integration documentation and AI-assisted tooling, and feed data-driven ideas from what you learn in-region into our org’s improvement pipeline and feature expansions.

- Be the voice of the MX/BR supplier. Add value with post-project analysis and case studies, influence our central product and tech teams on EDI/API tooling, and represent supplier needs internally.

- Deliver with rigor. Focus on goals with flexible prioritization and persistence; anticipate and overcome barriers; provide reliable reporting of your project activities, risks, mitigations, and outcomes; and make decisions that produce positive long-term impact.

- Communicate clearly to a wide range of audiences, from supplier IT teams to internal Directors — through status reports, narratives, and business/technical documentation.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience with APIs and technical integrations
- Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written
- Engineering/technical background (e.g., CS/CE/EE degree or equivalent hands-on experience) sufficient to ramp up quickly, understand system architectures, APIs, and data flows, and drive constructive technical discussions with engineers.
- Experience working with external service providers as part of integration delivery.
- Experience managing multiple external-facing integration or delivery projects in parallel, including working with external suppliers, customers, or third-party service providers.
- Demonstrated ability to work directly with external partners/customers and their technical teams, and to translate between business requirements and technical implementation.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
- Professional proficiency in Portuguese.
- Experience in the Mexico and/or Brazil supplier landscape, or working across LatAm markets.
- Direct experience integrating external suppliers/vendors onto EDI/API platforms, ideally in a retail or supply-chain context.
- Business-development or program-scaling mindset — a track record of using data to define and achieve results, building pitch/marketing material, and growing adoption of a technical program.
- Data fluency: comfortable collecting and using data (SQL, logs, APIs, BI artifacts) to define and measure results and to drive data-driven decisions.

descriptionHtml:
Every package delivered and every grocery order fulfilled depends on secure, reliable infrastructure. Within Customer Logistics Security (CLS), we build the software that discovers devices across Amazon's grocery stores and fulfillment centers and manages their vulnerabilities, keeping the systems our customers rely on protected. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead a team of software developers through this mission-critical work. You will own the technical direction and strategic roadmap for your team's security software, partner with Amazon Security, World Wide Operations, and Grocery stakeholders, and create an environment where engineers do their best work. If you are motivated by real-world security challenges and passionate about developing people, we want to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and grow a software development team focused on device discovery and vulnerability management, owning the team's charter, vision, and roadmap while aligning engineering goals to broader CLS objectives.
- Drive system design and architectural decisions, evaluating tradeoffs in scalability, maintainability, performance, and security to deliver software that protects Amazon's grocery and fulfillment infrastructure.
- Build a strong talent pipeline through effective hiring, onboarding, coaching, and career development for engineers at multiple levels.
- Partner with Amazon Security, World Wide Operations, and Grocery teams to prioritize work, resolve competing demands, and deliver solutions that address real security needs across the organization.
- Establish operational practices including metrics, audit mechanisms, and quality standards that keep your systems healthy and continuously improve the security posture of the devices you manage.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing vulnerability dashboards and device coverage metrics, then join a design review where you help your engineers refine their approach to a new detection capability. Midday, you connect with a partner in World Wide Operations to align on priorities for an upcoming rollout across fulfillment centers. In the afternoon, you hold a one-on-one with a direct report to discuss their growth plan and remove a blocker, then close the day by drafting a section of a strategic document that outlines your team's security roadmap for the year ahead.

About the team
We are a focused team of software developers within Customer Logistics Security, responsible for discovering and securing the devices that power Amazon's grocery stores and fulfillment centers. We partner closely with Amazon's broader security organization, World Wide Operations, and Grocery teams to keep critical infrastructure protected. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and a culture where every engineer has a voice in shaping what we build. title: Software Development Manager, Flight Software, Amazon Leo, Amazon Leo - Avionics End Point and FDIR
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to build software that flies in space? We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead a team responsible for the embedded firmware powering avionics endpoints on satellites. These endpoints serve three mission-critical functions: managing spacecraft attitude (orientation), generating power for all onboard systems, and communicating with ground stations on Earth.

As the manager of this team, you will hire, develop, and lead software engineers building flight software for satellites. You will work closely with hardware and peer software teams to deliver highly optimized, fault-tolerant software written in C++, Rust, and Python. Beyond the software running on the satellite itself, you will own the strategy and execution of a framework to detect, inject, and isolate faults across the entire spacecraft. This is a pivotal time to join — the team's charter is expanding with new investment as the program advances into its next stages, giving you the opportunity to shape both the technology and the team from the ground up.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead, hire, and develop a team of software engineers building mission-critical flight software for satellites, providing regular coaching, feedback, and career development planning to grow talent at every level.
- Define the technical direction and product roadmap for avionics endpoint firmware, balancing near-term delivery milestones with long-term architectural investments and operational excellence.
- Own the design and execution of a satellite-wide fault detection, injection, and isolation framework, partnering with hardware engineers, peer software teams, and release teams to align on priorities and dependencies.
- Drive program management practices that keep cross-functional efforts on track, including tracking progress, mitigating delivery risks, and communicating status to leadership and stakeholders.
- Evaluate and integrate generative AI and automation tools where appropriate to improve development workflows, testing coverage, and overall team productivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


A day in the life
You will start many mornings reviewing operational metrics and system health for your team's services, then shift into design discussions or code reviews with your engineers. Expect a mix of collaborative time — syncing with hardware partners on interface contracts, joining cross-team planning sessions — and focused work such as writing technical strategy documents or preparing roadmap updates for leadership. You will regularly coach team members one-on-one, unblock technical decisions, and communicate priorities across the organization. As the program scales, you will also spend time shaping hiring plans and onboarding new engineers to keep pace with the expanding charter.

About the team
Our team builds the software that keeps satellites safe, powered, and connected. We own the avionics endpoint firmware and the fault management framework that spans the entire spacecraft. As the program enters its next phase with expanded funding, we are growing the team and taking on new challenges that directly impact mission success. This is a place where you can build strategy skills, grow into a seasoned leader, and gain regular visibility with senior leadership — all while working on problems that literally orbit the Earth.
