title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Model Customization and Optimization), AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) on the Custom Model and Optimization team, you embed directly with strategic customers to build, optimize, and run custom generative AI models in production alongside their engineering teams. You own complete model workstreams end-to-end from defining the evaluation bar and preparing data, through training and inference optimization, to production deployment.

FDE IIs on this team works at the intersection of models and systems. They customize state-of-the-art open-weight and foundation models for new domains, languages, and modalities; migrate and optimize training and inference workloads on AWS Trainium and operate those models as production services. They are autonomous contributors who take on projects where the business goal is clear, but the path is not. They make design trade-offs with appropriate guidance, limit short-term workarounds, coach others on producing high-quality code, and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities
Embed within customer ML and engineering teams: Understand the customer's business, data, model stack, and operational constraints. Translate ambiguous goals into a measurable evaluation bar and a technical plan for your workstream such as model selection, customization approach, and serving architecture. Requires up to 25% travel.

Customize and post-train models. Adapt open-weight and foundation models to customer domains through continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning (including RLHF, RL with verifiable rewards, and multi-turn agentic RL). Build the data pipelines, synthetic data generation, and evaluation harnesses that prove a customized model out performs the baseline on the customer's own quality, latency, and cost bar. Apply these techniques to high-value patterns such as coding agents, domain foundation models, and multi-adapter serving.

Build large-scale training and inference systems. Design and implement distributed training and RL post-training pipelines using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP2, Megatron-LM, Miles, and verl. Build RL interaction harnesses using NeMo Gym or OpenEnv to connect agent workflows, tools, environments, and reward functions to training. Develop production inference stacks with engines such as SGLang and vLLM, and optimize throughput, latency, memory footprint, and cost per token through quantization, parallelism, speculative decoding, and batching.

Optimize models on AWS chips. Migrate and tune training and inference workloads for AWS Trainium using the AWS Neuron SDK. Profile performance, close accuracy-parity gaps against GPU baselines, and develop custom kernels where needed. Benchmark rigorously and turn results into decisions customers can act on.

Accelerate impact beyond the engagement. Codify reusable fine-tuning recipes, evaluation frameworks, benchmarking tools, and optimization patterns that accelerate future deployments. Feed field learnings back to AWS service teams, including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, and AWS Neuron. Identify opportunities to expand model customization and optimization within your customer engagement.

What you'll gain

This is hands-on experience you can't get just anywhere: leading people in a fast-paced, tech-forward environment, driving process improvement, and building operational expertise that's valued across the industry. title: Sr Manager, Portfolio Strategy , XCM
descriptionHtml:
The Portfolio Strategy & Planning team determines how Amazon invests its fixed marketing portfolio across the Amazon and Prime brands in North America. We build the planning frameworks, investment strategies, and inspection cycles that shape where, when, and how brand marketing shows up for customers. This is a strategy role. You will support and co-lead the analytical foundation that turns consumer research, business intelligence, media performance data, and econometric/ROI reads into investment recommendations for senior executive audiences. You will contribute to telling senior leaders where to invest, where to cut, and why. The primary output of this team is written memorandums for senior leadership (Directors upwards), so the ability to make data tell a clear story on paper without “marketing fluff” is the core skill.
You will work primarily with the Cross-Category and Channel Marketing (XCM) organization in North America, and partner closely with finance, measurement, performance marketing, and media planning teams. This is not a media planning role. Media planning is a close collaborator. Our job as Portfolio Strategists is to build the strategic scaffolding that media planning executes against.



Key job responsibilities
What You'll Do
- Support the annual Operating Plan (OP1/OP2) development for North America's fixed marketing portfolio, coordinating inputs from media, campaign teams, customer insights, finance, and measurement into a single integrated investment recommendation.
- Reconcile top-down financial guardrails with bottom-up media cost realities. Co-lead in defining the trade-offs and present them with a clear recommendation, not a menu of options.
- Own the Quarterly Business Review (QBR) process: inspect input and output metrics, surface risks early, and recommend course corrections with quantified impact.
- Manage spend tracking across budget owners (media, production, measurement) and coordinate quarterly guidance updates with Finance.
- Co-Lead bi-annual portfolio laydown reviews to ensure execution stays aligned to strategy. Flag drift and propose fixes.
- Synthesize consumer research, business intelligence, econometric models, and media performance data into a holistic view of which marketing bets to fund, scale, or cut.
- Support the development of investment strategies that optimize short- and long-term returns across Amazon's priority categories, including grocery and healthcare.
- Partner with business intelligence and measurement teams to improve marketing and customer lifecycle measurement. Push for better data where current reads are insufficient.
- Write and present high-quality documents to Directors and support in the creation of VP and SVP documents. Support in the translation of complex analytical findings into clear investment narratives.
- Build scalable planning processes and frameworks that allow the portfolio function to operate at the pace the business requires.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- 6+ years of developing and managing acquisition marketing or channel programs experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience in marketing (non-internship)
- Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
- Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint

title: Program Manager I, INTL Physical Security Innovation Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Physical Security team is looking for a Program Manager to help deliver physical security projects across our international network. Working within the team, you will own the day-to-day delivery of assigned projects end-to-end. Coordinating with site security teams, vendors and stakeholders to plan work, manage funding and approvals, track delivery and keep projects on time, on budget and to standard. It is a hands-on delivery role for someone early in their program-management career who enjoys turning plans into delivered outcomes in a fast-paced, multi-site environment.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end delivery of physical security projects across assigned sites and programs — from intake and funding preparation through deployment and handover.
• Support the team's senior program managers on their larger, more complex initiatives — tracking actions, chasing dependencies and helping keep delivery moving.
• Prepare and maintain project documentation, including statements of work, responsibility matrices and requirements.
• Support capital funding requests and manage the approvals workflow through to sign-off, tracking spend against approved funding, flagging variances and keeping stakeholders informed.
• Work directly with vendors and installers to schedule works, monitor progress and confirm delivery meets the agreed scope, standards and quality bar.
• Coordinate with site security teams and cross-functional partners to align on requirements, dependencies and timelines, escalating issues appropriately.
• Track project milestones and risks, driving early resolution or ensuring a clean hand-off to the right owner, and report accurate status and metrics into regular business reviews.
• Support proof-of-concept and pilot activity for new physical security technologies, gathering data and documenting outcomes.
• Ensure solutions are delivered in line with Amazon physical security standards and relevant regulatory, legal and safety requirements.
• Contribute to team process improvements — optimising the templates, trackers and workflows the team relies on to deliver.



A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing progress across your program and catching up with partners on solutions being validated across the international network. Mid-morning you join a working session with field security teams and stakeholders to define the problem behind an upcoming initiative and shape the requirements for a pilot, working through how a solution will integrate into live operations without slowing throughput. After lunch, you prepare a capital funding request for a program, pull together data from a recent proof-of-concept to strengthen the business case, and update your senior PM on key risks. Later you coordinate with a partner on a deployment timeline and capture the lessons from a completed pilot to inform the next rollout. Throughout it all, you balance careful planning with hands-on execution, moving solutions from pilot to network-wide reality.

About the team
The International (INTL) Physical Security Innovation Solutions team develops security solutions across Amazon's INTL network. We start from the problem, understanding our customers and the risks they face. We then develop, validate and scale solutions that remove manual security processes and let the network operate securely and efficiently. We take ideas from proof-of-concept through to fully-realized network-wide deployment solutions. We partner with field security teams, operations, and technology partners to prove what works and roll it out at scale. This role works alongside senior program managers and cross-functional partners to turn physical security innovation into reality across the INTL network.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of program or project management experience
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
- 3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
- Bachelor's degree in relevant field

title: Ingénieur projet maintenance industrielle (Expert Maintenance Support et développement), RME
descriptionHtml:
Notre équipe d’ingénieurs RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) veille à ce que nos équipements fonctionnent au mieux. Guidés par des responsables expérimentés, nous sommes une équipe à l’esprit analytique. Nos collaborateurs·trices possèdent à la fois des connaissances techniques poussées et un bon esprit d’équipe. Nous travaillons ensemble pour assurer l’entretien, le dépannage et la réparation des ressources de notre réseau mondial de centres d’expédition. Certains de nos employé·es occupent des postes à responsabilités et sont chargés de superviser l’équipe dans son travail sur des technologies passionnantes, dont certaines n’existent que chez Amazon.
De l’installation de systèmes d’emballage automatisés à la supervision de la maintenance générale d’un site, en passant par la réparation d’équipements de distribution essentiels, notre équipe assure le bon fonctionnement de la plupart des éléments techniques d’Amazon. Nous veillons, par exemple, à ce que les bâtiments soient conformes à la législation, afin d’assurer la sécurité de tous et le fonctionnement à plein régime de nos sites. Les possibilités d’évolution sont nombreuses, tant au sein de l’équipe RME qu’à l’échelle d’Amazon.
Tout ce que nous faisons vise à réduire les temps d’arrêt dans les principaux sites logistiques d’Amazon, afin que les clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps. Nous travaillons souvent tôt ou tard pour effectuer les tâches de maintenance avec un minimum de perturbations, y compris en équipes de nuit. Si nous voyons qu’il existe une méthodologie plus aboutie pour faire les choses, nous avons les compétences nécessaires pour développer et introduire des processus nouveaux ou des technologies de pointe, comme Amazon Robotics ou notre robot de tri ultra sophistiqué.

Key job responsibilities
Nous créons une nouvelle équipe RME chez Amazon, et nous cherchons des profils comme le vôtre pour la composer.
Votre mission ?
Vous serez le point de contact clé pour nos techniciens sur site. À distance, vous les guiderez, les soutiendrez dans leur développement, et résoudrez avec eux des problèmes techniques complexes pour maintenir nos opérations en marche.
Concrètement, vous allez :


- Résoudre des problèmes d'équipement à distance pour réduire les temps d'arrêt (sur différents shift avec nuit inclus)
- Accompagner et développer nos techniciens terrain comme leur premier point de contact (déplacements sur plusieurs sites à envisager)
- Appliquer et faire respecter les meilleures pratiques de sécurité
- Identifier des opportunités d'amélioration continue et harmoniser les processus à l'échelle européenne
Nous recherchons des profils expérimentés et sommes ouvert aux techniciens expert en fiabilisation/formation technique par exemple.

Pourquoi rejoindre cette équipe ?
Vous ferez partie d'un projet pilote innovant, avec des technologies de pointe, des opportunités de formation continues, et la possibilité de façonner les standards de maintenance pour tout le réseau européen d'Amazon.
C'est une opportunité rare de construire quelque chose de nouveau, tout en développant votre carrière dans un environnement qui valorise l'innovation et l'apprentissage.
Pourquoi c'est différent ?
- Vous construisez les règles du jeu (pas de "on a toujours fait comme ça")
- Vous évoluez vite (nouvelles compétences, nouvelles responsabilités, nouveau territoire)
- Votre impact est européen (pas juste local)
- Vous travaillez avec les meilleures technologies et les meilleurs talents

A day in the life
À chaque quart de travail, vous serez à la tête d'une équipe en vous assurant que tous ses membres disposent du matériel nécessaire et que celui-ci fonctionne parfaitement. Cela implique la supervision des processus pour veiller au respect des normes et des politiques, ainsi que de garantir que l'entretien préventif approprié est effectué pour augmenter le temps de fonctionnement des équipements.

À partir de ce que vous observerez lors de vos quarts de travail, vous proposerez des améliorations destinées à augmenter l'efficacité et la productivité de nos systèmes et, par la suite, vous mettrez en œuvre ces changements dans tous nos centres de l'UE. Vous devrez également utiliser des outils tels que Scada pour superviser les processus afin de garantir leur performance, en plus de collaborer étroitement avec votre superviseur direct dans les tâches administratives.

Votre lieu de travail sera l'un de nos centres opérationnels. Vous travaillerez par quarts, ce qui peut inclure certains week-ends et nuits. À mesure que vous acquerrez de l'expérience dans ce secteur si fascinant d'Amazon.

About the team
Notre équipe d'ingénieurs de maintenance et de fiabilité (RME) est responsable du bon fonctionnement de nos systèmes à plein rendement. Nous nous caractérisons par notre grande aptitude technique et notre excellente capacité de travail en équipe, dirigés par des responsables ayant une grande expérience. Notre travail comprend la maintenance, la réparation et la résolution de problèmes liés aux équipements dans tout notre réseau mondial de centres de distribution. L'équipe dispose d'une série de profils de direction qui sont chargés de superviser le développement de technologies fascinantes, dont certaines n'existent que chez Amazon.

Notre équipe s'occupe de la plupart des aspects techniques d'Amazon, en effectuant des tâches allant de l'installation de systèmes d'emballage automatisés à la supervision de la maintenance générale d'un centre ou à la réparation d'équipements clés de distribution. Cela inclut l'adaptation des bâtiments à la législation en vigueur, afin que tout le personnel soit en sécurité et que nos installations fonctionnent avec la plus grande efficacité possible. L'équipe RME, comme c'est le cas dans d'autres départements d'Amazon, offre de nombreuses opportunités de progression professionnelle.

Tout notre travail tourne autour de la réduction des périodes d'inactivité dans les centres d'opérations cruciales d'Amazon, afin que les clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps.

Basic qualifications

- Une expérience confirmée en maintenance (électricité + automatisme)
- Pédagogue avec une bonne communication (vous savez expliquer, rassurer, et motiver à distance)
- Une appétence pour les nouvelles technologies (vous êtes curieux et vous adaptez vite)
- Un esprit d'équipe et une envie d'avoir un impact réel
- Niveau d'anglais: niveau Intermédiaire ou courant (avoir un minimum de bases pour effectuer des calls)

Preferred qualifications

- Les compétences souhaitables sont un plus, mais ne sont pas obligatoires pour postuler au poste. Si vous remplissez les conditions de base mentionnées, nous serions ravis de vous rencontrer.
- Expérience dans des environnements avec de nombreux prestataires et sur différents sites, en interaction avec une multitude de sous-traitants et différentes localisations.
- Vous comprenez les systèmes de contrôle basés sur des automates programmables (PLC) et les exigences réglementaires.
- Expérience dans l'utilisation de systèmes informatiques permettant de planifier la maintenance proactive et d'enregistrer les tâches réactives.
- Diplôme universitaire, de préférence dans une discipline technique, en gestion des opérations ou en administration des entreprises.

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. title: Software Development Engineer II, ADC2S
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 7, 2026

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) control-plane services in air-gapped regions. You will help governments run secure cloud infrastructure at scale.

In this role, you will join a team of engineers who build and operate software for EC2's control plane, fleet health, and capacity operations in air-gapped cloud environments. You will own features and services from design through production, make sound trade-offs within your area, and help raise the quality of what the team ships. Commercial tooling often does not exist in isolated regions, so you will build what the team needs instead of configuring an off-the-shelf product.

The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate EC2 control-plane services, fleet health automation, and capacity tooling across air-gapped cloud environments.
- Own features end to end: write the design, implement and test the code, deploy it through pipelines to disconnected regions, and operate it in production, including on-call.
- Improve monitoring, alarming, and deployment safety for the services you own, and drive the fix when an operational issue reveals a gap.
- Work with partner teams and stakeholders across the air-gapped partitions to deliver shared infrastructure.
- Take part in design and code reviews, and help new engineers ramp up on the team's systems.
- Use generative artificial intelligence tools and techniques to improve automation, code quality, and team productivity.

A day in the life
You might start the morning finishing a design document for a new capacity automation feature, then review a teammate's code change to how instance lifecycle events are processed in a disconnected region. After lunch, you work with a partner team to get your change into a shared deployment pipeline, then spend the afternoon tracking down the root cause of an alarm from last night's on-call shift. You write code most days, and you are expected to propose better ways to automate capacity and remediation workflows in the systems you own.

About the team
We own the software that keeps EC2 running in the air-gapped partitions: control-plane services, fleet-health automation, and the capacity tooling our government customers depend on. We operate what we build, so the engineers who design a remediation workflow are the ones it pages. Because the commercial tooling for a problem frequently does not exist in an isolated region, you build the thing rather than configure it. The team defaults to written design documents and clear ownership boundaries, and you will work alongside engineers who are passionate about solving hard infrastructure problems in the most demanding regulated cloud environments.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive as a trusted partner to a senior leader, anticipating what's next and keeping the business moving? Do you believe details matter and want to help a fast-moving leadership team stay focused on what counts?

We are looking for a well organized, self-motivated Executive Assistant (EA) to support the Executive of AWS Field Experiences and the broader AFX leadership team at Amazon Web Services. We want someone driven and resourceful who has a record of high performance. The role calls for sharp attention to detail, strong judgment on priorities, and the ability to plan ahead and hit tight deadlines while juggling several critical requests.

In this role, you will:

- Act as a strategic partner to the Executive, making sure their time matches business priorities and making judgment calls on where their attention matters most

You hold yourself to a high standard of integrity and discretion with confidential information, and you're polished and professional with leaders inside and outside Amazon. You're also curious about AI-powered productivity tools and use them to work smarter, automating routine scheduling, meeting prep, and follow-ups so you can focus on higher-value work.

title: Design Program Manager, Enterprise, Worldwide Grocery Retail Growth & Development (WWRGD)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Grocery Retail Growth & Development (WWRGD), Enterprise Design team is seeking a Design Manager to own the end-to-end design function of the PERF (Project and Equipment Request Form) program across our entire grocery store fleet.

This is an exciting role for a design leader who can operate at the intersection of design quality and operational scale. You are the right person for this job if you are a creative problem solver with a passion for customers, strong program management instincts, and the ability to drive high-volume design work efficiently and consistently. In this role, you will own the entire Design PERF workstream — from deciding which projects need design, to prioritizing and resourcing the work, to executing and delivering design solutions for equipment replacements, brand refreshes, and other in-store improvement projects. Not every PERF project requires design intervention, and a key part of this role is building the judgment and systems to identify which ones do and get them done well.

You will serve as the primary design partner to the PERF Construction Management team, equipment and procurement partners, and store operations stakeholders. You will define the standards and toolkits that make design delivery repeatable at scale, and you will be the senior design voice for the program, ensuring every project is grounded in strong design thinking and delivered efficiently. We are looking for someone who is comfortable moving quickly, communicating clearly at all levels, and taking end-to-end ownership in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.

We are a fast-moving business unit where everyone is entrepreneurial, wears many hats, and works effectively in a highly collaborative environment. The ideal candidate is a creative problem solver with strong program management instincts, a passion for customers, and the ability to build scalable design systems that work across a high-volume portfolio.

Key job responsibilities
- End-to-End Workstream Ownership: Own the entire Design PERF workstream, establishing the processes and standards that govern how design requests are received, prioritized, resourced, and delivered.
- Design Intake and Prioritization: Establish criteria for which PERF projects require design intervention and own prioritization across the portfolio, triaging requests by urgency, strategic importance, and operational impact
- Resourcing: Match project needs to internal and external design capacity and proactively identify gaps.
- Design Execution: Lead and execute design work for PERF scope, equipment replacements, breakroom and restroom refreshes, and in-store improvement projects to brand standards and operational requirements.
- Design Standards and Toolkits: Develop and maintain scalable design standards and toolkits for PERF project types, enabling consistent, repeatable solutions across the fleet.
- Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as the primary design counterpart to Construction, equipment, and procurement partners, providing guidance and documentation from intake through installation.
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with store leaders, Operations, Area leadership, and WWRGD partners to align on scope, priorities, and design intent. Communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership demonstrating strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Process Improvement and Reporting: Identify and implement process efficiencies, track design delivery KPIs, and provide regular status updates to WWRGD leadership.

A day in the life
If you thrive in a dynamic, high-volume environment where design rigor and operational pace must coexist, then we want to talk to you. A typical day involves triaging new PERF design requests, advancing active design packages, and coordinating with the Capital Planning and Construction teams to ensure design handoffs are clean and complete. You will regularly interface with store operations leaders to ground design decisions in real store context, partner with procurement on equipment specifications, and advance process improvements that help the team scale. This role requires both design judgment and program management discipline — you will need to move quickly, communicate clearly, and maintain quality across a portfolio of hundreds of active projects at any given time.

The Enterprise Design team leads the transformation of our existing grocery locations through strategic remodels and innovations. We enhance the shopping experience by modernizing store layout, improving operational efficiency, and implementing the latest brand standards, all while stores remain open for business. Our customer-obsessed design approach focuses on creating seamless shopping experiences for both in-store and online customers, while ensuring our operations teams can work safely and efficiently during and after remodels.

- Experience understanding needs of business and end customers and translating them into right solutions

title: Risk Manager II, AWS Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) is seeking a Risk Specialist to join our team within Risk Management Excellence (RMX). In this role, you will help identify, assess, and manage enterprise-level risks that could affect AWS’s operations, strategy, and compliance posture.

You will support the enterprise risk assessment lifecycle, maintain and enhance the risk register, evaluate mitigating activities, and produce risk insights that informs executive decision-making. You will partner with stakeholders across AWS—including service teams, finance, legal, compliance, and security—to ensure risks are consistently identified, measured, escalated, and mitigated within a structured governance framework.
The ideal candidate is analytically rigorous, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across organizational boundaries in a fast-moving cloud infrastructure environment. You bring a strong foundation in risk frameworks and a passion for translating complex risk data into clear, actionable insights for senior leaders.

Key job responsibilities
You will conduct enterprise risk assessments across AWS business units, identifying emerging and evolving risks through structured interviews, data analysis, and environmental scanning. You will maintain and enhance the enterprise risk register, ensuring risk owners are assigned, ratings are current, and mitigation plans are tracked to completion. You will produce executive-level risk reports and dashboards that translate complex opportunities into clear, decision-ready insights for senior leadership. You will support regulatory compliance efforts by coordinating evidence gathering, responding to audit inquiries, and tracking remediation activities. As a cross-functional risk advisor, you will partner with service teams, finance, legal, and security to embed risk awareness into business processes and strategic planning. You will contribute to the development and maintenance of risk policies, frameworks, and methodologies aligned to industry standards. Throughout, you will look for AWS ERM
opportunities to automate workflows, improve data quality, and scale the program’s reach through better tooling and processes.

A day in the life
You start the day reviewing risk register updates and flagging items that need follow-up with risk owners. You shift to project work: conducting a risk assessment interview with a service team, building out a dashboard for an upcoming leadership review, or evaluating control effectiveness for a compliance inquiry. You may join a cross-functional call with Legal or Finance to align on an emerging risk theme. Refining assessment methodologies, drafting policy updates, or working with engineering on a workflow automation.

About the team
Professional certifications such as CRISC, CISA, CISM, CRM, or equivalent.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Key job responsibilities

You will design homework that produces the signal each study needs, keep it clear and achievable for testers, drive completion, and analyze the results to turn tester activity into actionable findings for program and product teams.

Success in this role comes from strong operational execution, attention to detail, clear and empathetic communication, and the ability to coordinate many moving parts without dropping any. This role includes direct responsibility for program management of system level development, integration, and test of production value stream. This is a highly technical role requiring experience with data analytics, data modeling, integrated hardware and software as well as some appreciation for complex applications and manufacturing systems.

Candidate superpowers should include ownership, insist on high standards, stakeholder management, influencing without authority, innovation, creating clarity out of ambiguity, and enabling productive collaboration.

Key job responsibilities

- Translate strategic goals into actionable plans for specific projects and operations.
- Understand dependencies between roadmap projects, synchronize milestones, identify constraints and dive deep where necessary to unblock and deliver the roadmap.
- Create new tools and business processes that simplify, standardize and enable operational excellence across the entire production value stream.
- Develop and own operational rhythms for all of production operations teams
- Identify potential risks in manufacturing processes and develop mitigation strategies and recovery plans.
- Execute a strategic plan that defines how teams will deliver on forward looking production plans.
- Support the development and execution of Production Rate Ramp roadmaps.
- Partner with business teams on scalable, standardized approaches to meet their demand and enable growth.
- Drive the creation, documentation, and adoption of scalable, standardized, and highly visible processes across all supply chain, manufacturing and launch functions.
- Drive executive communication cadence and deliver artifacts that provide insight into the activities, accomplishments, challenges and risks of operations to senior leadership.
- Measure, analyze, improve, and control KPIs across all aspects of the operation.
- Work with software and analytics teams to develop reporting tools and applications that support, operating rhythms
- Analyze production data to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
- Support implementation training on new processes or improvements identified through PDCA cycles
- Drive year over year optimization opportunities in all areas of operations, including manufacturing and sourcing.
- Provide feedback/escalate systemic concerns to tech teams regarding approaches that are cost-inefficient or detrimental to scaling.

- Create new tools and business processes that simplify, standardize and enable operational excellence across the entire production value stream.

A day in the life
This role will be highly collaborative, requiring partnerships with cross-functional production stakeholders to drive positive results. This role requires the ability to advocate on behalf of our customers (internal and external) and an ability to push back without being adversarial.

This role will be supporting production of satellite operations across our facilities in Redmond and Kirkland, WA. A typical day for this role will be working directly with production teams and value stream owners on plan execution and check process adherence. Throughout the day, an Sr. Operations TPM for satellite manufacturing must balance strategic planning with hands-on oversight of project execution. Communication skills are crucial, as they interact with various stakeholders including customers, suppliers, and internal teams. The role requires strong leadership to motivate and coordinate teams towards achieving project goals while maintaining a focus on quality, efficiency, and adherence to timelines.

Overall, the role demands strategic thinking, effective leadership, and meticulous oversight to drive satellite manufacturing projects forward successfully. This role will tackle challenging, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot, have fun and make a positive impact on millions of people.

Du verantwortest das End-to-End-Mitarbeitererlebnis an deinen Standorten: von Feedback-Mechanismen und Anerkennungsprogrammen bis hin zu Arbeitsplatzstandards, die Vertrauen schaffen, Engagement fördern und Leistung nachhaltig steigern. Diese Rolle ist standortbasiert und umfasst regelmäßige Mobilität zwischen mehreren Standorten innerhalb deines regionalen Campus.

Key job responsibilities
Employee Experience & Engagement

- Förderung einer offenen Zwei-Wege-Kommunikation zwischen Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften durch Instrumente wie Voice of the Associate, Rundtischgespräche und GEMBA-Walks

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Engagement-Strategien und Anerkennungsprogrammen, die Mitarbeitende spürbar wertschätzen

- Schaffung eines Umfelds, in dem sich alle Mitarbeitenden sicher, gehört und einbezogen fühlen

- Regelmäßige und sichtbare Präsenz auf der Betriebsfläche — frühzeitige Anzeichen von Desengagement erkennen und aktiv darauf reagieren



Operational Excellence & Standortstandards

- Regelmäßige Standortbegehungen zur Bewertung der Arbeitsbedingungen und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Amazon-Standards

- Zusammenarbeit mit Standortleitungen und Safety-Teams, um Sicherheitsprogramme an deinen Standorten konsequent umzusetzen

- Leitung von Community-Initiativen an deinen Standorten in Zusammenarbeit mit dem gesamten Netzwerk sowie den Teams für Public Policy und Public Relations

- Steigerung der Standorteffektivität durch die Identifikation systemischer Muster, Behebung von Ursachen und konsequente, faire Anwendung von Richtlinien



Datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung & Technologie

- Nutzung von Datenanalysen, um aufkommende Trends zu erkennen, Herausforderungen frühzeitig zu antizipieren und proaktive Lösungen umzusetzen

- Förderung der Nutzung von HR-Technologielösungen, KI-Tools und Self-Service-Plattformen — bei gleichzeitiger Sicherstellung eines persönlichen Service in entscheidenden Momenten



Strategische PXT-Führung

- Coaching von Business Leaders zu effektiven Personalmanagement-Praktiken — einschließlich Leistungsfeedback, Teamentwicklung und Mitarbeiterbeziehungsthemen

A day in the life
Kein Tag gleicht dem anderen — und genau das macht diese Rolle so spannend. Dein Arbeitsalltag ist eine dynamische Mischung aus strategischem Denken und praktischer Problemlösung. Du nutzt fortgeschrittene Analysen und KI-gestützte Tools, um Trends zu erkennen, die Bedürfnisse deiner Standorte zu antizipieren und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die das Arbeitsplatzerlebnis wirklich verbessern.

Durch unternehmerisches Denken, datenbasierte Erkenntnisse und starke Partnerschaften trägst du dazu bei, eine Kultur zu schaffen, in der sich alle Mitarbeitenden wertgeschätzt und gestärkt fühlen.

title: Data Quality Specialist - Polish, AGI Data Services - G T Quality
descriptionHtml:
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
* Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.

Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).

You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.

About the team
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Polish
- Intermediate-level proficiency in English (B2+ or equivalent fluency by CEFR standards)
- 1+ years of experience in a quality assurance, quality control, or data quality role
- Experience defining, tracking, and reporting quality metrics or KPIs
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop prescriptive actions
- Experience working with data to identify trends, patterns, and quality issues
- Ability to create and maintain process documentation, SOPs, or quality guidelines

Preferred qualifications

title: Software Dev Engineer, Pricing Shared Platform
descriptionHtml:
Pricing Shared Services team owns the core set of systems which decides prices of products sold by Amazon Retail. The team owns system data vending, notification and price publishing systems which are used by multiple pricing strategy teams for building their price recommendation and submission of their recommended prices. These systems scale to thousands of TPS and computes prices for billions of listing every month. We are building new services that radically scales publishing capacity of our systems while making our services multi-tenant to support Amazon's growing number of businesses. We collaborate with product, science, and business teams to figure out new ideas. We innovate by applying state-of-the-art computer science to define, design, and build our systems. And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop services using your expertise and experience with a variety of technologies. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Amazon Leo Country Expansion
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

The Sr. Product Manager – Technical (PM-T) will lead the discovery, definition, and delivery of capabilities required to launch and expand Amazon Leo's eCommerce presence into new geographies. This role involves working on complex, high-impact challenges — from understanding regulatory and technical requirements unique to each market, to building scalable solutions that accelerate country readiness.

The PM-T will partner closely with engineering, legal, and business teams to define requirements, drive technical architecture decisions, and ensure the right foundations are in place for a successful launch. This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of product strategy and technical execution, with direct impact on Amazon Leo's global expansion roadmap.

Key job responsibilities
Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for country expansion, setting the technical direction for launching eCommerce into new geographies while balancing speed-to-market with longterm scalability

Own and instrument readiness as a gating input metric for country launch sequencing. Define, track, and optimize compliance readiness scores across target geographies to accelerate launch timelines.

Identify and prioritize regulatory, technical, and customer experience requirements across the full LBGUPS (Learn, Buy, Get, Use, Pay, Serve) journey, translating country-specific needs into clear product specifications for engineering teams.

Serve as the single-threaded owner for cross-functional alignment across engineering, legal, finance, operations, and business development, ensuring launch milestones and dependencies are clearly defined and tracked

Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership through well-structured written documents, and establish launch readiness criteria to validate country readiness before go-live

Capture learnings from each launch to continuously improve the expansion playbook and identify opportunities to automate repeatable country tasks.

Conduct direct customer discovery in target geographies to validate LBGUPS journey gaps and distinguish regulatory constraints from genuine customer needs.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life
As a Sr. PM-T on the Country Expansion team, your day is a blend of technical problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration. You'll work with engineering, legal, and business teams across geographies to define requirements, resolve blockers, and drive decisions that determine whether a new country launches on time. From reviewing country-specific technical solutions to aligning on Shared Capabilities that accelerate future expansions, every decision you make today builds the foundation for customers in new geographies to seamlessly discover, buy, and receive products.

About the team
The Country Expansion team is at the forefront of bringing Amazon Leo's eCommerce experience to customers in new geographies. We tackle some of the most complex and rewarding challenges in the company — navigating country-specific regulatory requirements, building Shared Capabilities that scale across geographies, and partnering with teams across engineering, legal, finance, and operations to make every launch a success. If you're energized by ambiguity, thrive at the intersection of technical depth and strategic thinking, and want your work to directly shape how millions of new customers experience Amazon Leo for the first time, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
- Experience in ecommerce for a global product or service
- Experience launching products or programs in new international markets
- Experience identifying and prioritizing regulatory, technical, and customer experience requirements

title: InfraOps Support Engineer, Operations Management Center (OMC)
descriptionHtml:
The InfraOps Support Engineer is a Tier 1 support engineer in Amazon's Operations Management Center (OMC) - a 24/7/365 team that keeps the technology inside Amazon's 400+ corporate office buildings running across Networking, Audio-Visual (AV), and Print services. This engineer is the first line of response for office-infrastructure incidents.

Operating within the Amazon Support Engineer (SupEng) job family, the engineer provides high-quality support across all three service areas while beginning to develop deep subject-matter expertise in one or more focus areas, for which they become the technical point of contact on their team. They respond, triage and resolve incidents within target times using established procedures, detect trends before they become problems, contribute to and refine the team's operating procedures, and mentor more junior engineers. Success requires the ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative, shift-based environment.

Key job responsibilities
On a typical shift, an InfraOps Support Engineer will:

1. Monitor, Detect & Triage

Be the first line of response and keep ahead of problems.

Triage incoming incidents (tickets) within defined target response times, using judgment to resolve in place or route to the responsible team.

Use dashboards, alarms, and other tools for Networking, AV, and Print services across the global building fleet, interpreting what those signals indicate to solve incidents.

Detect ongoing trends or emerging problems before they occur and define proactive actions to prevent customer impact.

Assess incident scope and severity, correlate related incidents into a single parent incident, and prioritise work against SLAs.

2. Troubleshoot & Support

Resolve issues and support the team's products and systems.

Provide high-quality Tier 1 support for the products and systems in the team's scope, resolving straightforward problems with limited documentation and minimal escalation.

Support critical issues using existing runbooks; maintain composure through difficult interactions until the issue is resolved.

Perform on-call duties on a rotating schedule and respond to emergent events.

Escalate appropriately when resolution requires significant deviation from procedure or when an issue becomes a risk.

3. Subject-Matter Expertise & Technical Leadership

Grow into the go-to person for a focus area.

Develop and apply expertise in one or more focus areas (e.g., Networking, AV, or Print), acting as the technical point of contact for that area within the team.

Give technical direction to others and impart knowledge to users, customers, and teammates.

Lead internal team projects and deliver on defined goals and timelines.

4. Documentation & Operational Improvement

Improve how the team operates.

Identify areas to improve support documentation and processes, and author new runbooks/SOPs and knowledge-base articles where gaps exist.

Identify improvements to existing and new support tools that increase operational efficiency, and help drive their implementation.

Help develop and refine the operational policies and procedures used by the team.

5. Mentoring & Collaboration

Raise the bar for the team.

Serve as a mentor to junior engineers and act as a training buddy for new hires; may assist in hiring activities.

Maintain good working relationships across Amazon and work cross-functionally with partner teams to solve problems and improve processes.

Communicate infrastructure health and trends clearly, both in real time and as inputs to weekly/monthly business reviews.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with Windows server technologies: AD, DFS, Print Services, SCCM
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
- Experience in IT client, server, and network service delivery
- Experience with networking technology (TCP/IP, subnetting, DNS and DHCP)
- Experience supporting Windows, Mac and/or Linux operating systems in a corporate setting
- Experience working in large-scale networking environments
- High school diploma, or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in computer networking
- Experience in network and operating system support
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in Network protocols like DNS/DHCP/TCP

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 10, 2026

About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of repairing material handling equipment (MHE), automated conveyor systems, or related mechanical/controls equipment experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 1+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience
- Experience with material handling equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and safety standards

title: Supply Chain Security Compliance Specialist, Supply Chain and Intellectual Property Security
descriptionHtml:
We're seeking a Security Supply Chain Assessor to help protect Amazon's global supply chain through security assessments and risk management. This role requires international travel (up to 75%) across APAC, North America, and South America Regions.
The Cybersecurity Supply Chain Assessor plays a critical role in evaluating and strengthening the security posture of third-party manufacturing and supplier partners across the global supply chain. This position involves conducting on-site cybersecurity assessments of supplier facilities, verifying adherence to corporate and industry security standards, and identifying risks related to data protection, software provisioning, and hardware production environments.
The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in cybersecurity controls, a strong understanding of manufacturing and supplier ecosystems, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with internal and external stakeholders across multiple time zones and regions.


Key job responsibilities
• Conduct on-site cybersecurity assessments of suppliers and contract manufacturers across APAC, North America, and South America.
• Building virtualized environments.
• Building and running AI agent.
• Evaluate supplier environments against company and industry security standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST 800-171, and internal security frameworks).
• Assess security domains including but not limited to:
o Network segmentation and access control
o Data encryption and protection mechanisms
o Endpoint and server security
o Secure software provisioning and storage
o Incident response and monitoring practices
o Physical and environmental security controls
• Document findings, develop risk ratings, and provide actionable remediation guidance to suppliers.
• Partner with internal security, compliance, and supply chain teams to ensure continuous improvement of supplier risk management programs.
• Track, monitor, and verify closure of remediation actions through follow-up assessments or evidence reviews.
• Contribute to the development and enhancement of standardized assessment frameworks, methodologies, and automation tools.
• Provide training and knowledge-sharing sessions for suppliers and internal stakeholders to improve overall security maturity.
• Maintain awareness of evolving global cybersecurity regulations, threats, and best practices relevant to the manufacturing and supply chain ecosystem.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Security, Computer Science, Risk Management, Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent technology experience

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.

Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.

title: Sr. Customer Advocacy Manager, US Immigration
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Immigration is seeking a strategic and results-oriented US Sr. Customer Advocacy Manager to lead, build, and develop the team that owns our end-to-end escalations program across Amazon’s US business. This is a people-management role with direct reports, operating at the intersection of complex case management, program strategy, organizational leadership, and service excellence.

As US immigration policy shifts rapidly — including changes to green card processes, H-1B petitions, visa applications, etc. — this leader will architect a scalable, proactive escalations framework that drives service defects down and customer satisfaction up, safeguarding employee experience throughout the immigration lifecycle. This leader sets direction for the escalations program, builds team capability and capacity, and serves as a senior escalation authority trusted to make high-judgment calls in an ambiguous regulatory environment — operating as a force multiplier through the people they develop. This leader will also serve as a strategic advisor to the Global Immigration Strategy single threaded leader, sitting on the leadership team.

Key job responsibilities
Lead and develop the US escalations team — manage, coach, and own the full people lifecycle (hiring, performance, calibration, and career growth), building the team's capability to resolve complex escalations without your intervention.
Own US immigration escalations strategy as the single-threaded leader — strategy, metrics, RCA/COE processes, and proactive mechanisms that drive service defects down across all US categories.
Lead emergent policy and crisis response — flex team capacity to review and respond to emergent US immigration policy and crisis issues as they arise; partner with providers, internal operations, Legal, Public Policy, and the business to design, implement, and communicate timely, compliant responses that protect the employee experience.
Partner and influence cross-functionally — serve as senior escalation authority to providers, Legal, Public Policy, Product, Tech, HR, and leaders up to L10; author the COEs, MBR/QBR inputs, and narratives that shape how leadership understands US immigration risk.
Drive data-driven continuous improvement — own escalation metrics, SLA/CSAT performance, and the escalations inputs into OP1/OP2 planning and headcount cycles.

A day in the life
In this role, you will manage a team of high-performing customer escalations immigration specialists, helping these professionals better support our toughest customer issues - at scale. You will optimize team structure, systems, and processes, coach and grow your people, devise new strategies to solve customer problems before they happen, and serve as a key advisor and leadership team member supporting the Global Immigration Strategy leader.

About the team
In the Immigration team at Amazon, we aim to give sponsored employees peace of mind, knowing that their immigration matters are in the hands of experts, so they can focus on what they do best, inventing the future. The team is full of immigration experts, process mavens, and escalations specialists, all working together in a collegial, supportive, and fast-paced environment.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law, Computer Science, Finance, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research or a related field
- Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities
- 3+ years of partnering with cross functional teams experience
- Experience managing direct reports
- 7+ years of corporate US immigration experience in a high-volume environment — you have operated as a subject-matter expert managing nonimmigrant and green card employment-based immigration at scale (large caseloads, multiple concurrent matters, tight SLAs, complex program management).

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of leading large complex programs experience
- Knowledge of compensation/total rewards, talent management, performance management, compliance, and organization design and development
- Experience managing cross-functional projects and initiatives
- Experience in team management and building (including coaching and mentoring)
- Knowledge of process improvement, ideally including Lean, Kaizen and Six Sigma
- experience as a corporate immigration attorney, specialist, or case worker.
- Experience navigating rapidly evolving US government immigration policy and translating regulatory changes into operational action.
- Demonstrated ability to flex team capacity to address urgent, emergent US immigration policy issues — leading cross-functional review, response design, and communication under rapidly changing regulatory conditions.

This position will be part of an exciting, fast-moving business unit, where everyone on the team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats and work effectively in a highly collaborative environment. You will drive deliverables through architecture and engineering consultants as well as in-house store design, construction and procurement teams. You are the right person for this job if you have a strong end user focus and a passion for producing high-quality work. You must take ownership of your work, display a great deal of initiative, possess common sense, sound judgment, and a sense of humor.

Key job responsibilities

Preferred qualifications

title: Supply Chain Manager, WWGS - SCOPE (Supply Chain Optimization Planning & Execution)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Grocery Stores (WWGS) SCOPE team is looking for a Supply Chain Manager to plan, execute, and continuously improve how inventory moves from Amazon's All Temperature Distribution Centers (ATDCs) to the customer-facing Amazon Now sites.

Amazon Now is an ultra-fast delivery service that brings fresh groceries and everyday household essentials to your doorstep in 30 minutes or less. You will partner across ATDC Inbound, Outbound, and Transportation, along with site operations, planning, and tech teams, to deliver inventory in full and on time at a competitive cost. The ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, makes sound data-driven judgments quickly, and keeps building depth in both the business and the technology behind it.

Key job responsibilities
- Own ATDC-to-spoke distribution performance across quality (OTIF, defects), cost, and capacity, and lead root-cause analysis when results slip.
- Work with inbound, outbound, and transportation leaders to align S&OP, labor, and carrier capacity plans, and flag risks early with clear mitigation plans.
- Escalate network constraints such as inbound gridlock, capacity shortfalls, or carrier gaps, and drive them to lasting fixes.
- Lead process improvements and automation that lower cost-to-serve and reduce manual intervention.
- Build scalable mechanisms and tech requirements so the network adapts to demand spikes, new business formats, and unexpected requirements.
- Deliver weekly and monthly business reviews that give leadership a clear view of performance, risks, and next steps.

About the team
SCOPE is made up of the ATDC Inbound, ATDC Outbound, and ATDC Transportation teams. Our focus is three-pronged: quality (free of defects), efficiency (low cost), and scalability (robustness and automation). We're building a reliable, versatile, and efficient distribution network that moves inventory in full at the time promised, at a competitive cost structure, with the robustness and self-adaptiveness to meet unexpected requirements.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
- 2+ years of supply chain experience
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience with SQL
- Experience with MS Share-point
- Experience in data mining
- Experience in grocery, perishables, or multi-temperature distribution
