title: Software Development Engineer, RBS Tech
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about building the future of Retail Automation powered by Generative AI?

Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon's Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enriches ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination, where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow; and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops intelligent automation powered by GenAI, LLM and Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of highly complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time.

Why join us

We believe in "Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History" value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you love designing elegant abstractions for messy real world problems, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you get a kick out of seeing your code improve the shopping experience for millions of customers worldwide, we definitely need you. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too.

About the role

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands, customer obsession is part of our company DNA. We are seeking a Software Development Engineer II to join the SAMAI team and help us push the boundaries of what's possible with Generative AI in retail automation. As an SDE2, you will not just write code, you will architect systems that think. You will design scalable, distributed platforms that orchestrate LLM powered agents, build robust pipelines that process millions of data points daily, and make critical design trade offs that directly influence a multi billion dollar business. You will work at the intersection of Generative AI, distributed systems and real world business impact. Every system you build will be tested against the unforgiving scale of Amazon's catalog, hundreds of millions of ASINs, dozens of marketplaces and billions of customer interactions. You will collaborate closely with Applied Scientists and senior engineers to turn cutting edge research into production systems that work at scale. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges.

If you enjoy designing and building GenAI powered platforms, highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come join us!

Work/Life Balance

RBS Tech team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship and Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal and Senior Engineers from RBS Tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'Reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications. And on a team building Gen AI systems every day, the learning opportunities are endless.

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for a sharp, experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You take on projects and make software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new team-mates on how your team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

About the team

We are building SAMAI, our Gen AI powered automation platform that is redefining how RBS delivers at scale. SAMAI harnesses the power of LLMs, agentic AI workflows and cutting edge ML to automate complex retail business processes end to end. Think of it as the brain behind RBS's next generation automation, orchestrating intelligent agents that can reason, act and deliver outcomes that previously needed hundreds of human hours. We are not just using Gen AI as a feature; we are building a platform that makes GenAI the foundation of retail operations.

You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You take on projects and make software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new team-mates on how your team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Data Centers are industry leading examples of innovation in the areas of security, safety, space utilization, efficiency, and cost effectiveness. We are the global team responsible for the construction of the Amazon owned sites.
The EMEA Data Center Construction team is looking for a Senior Pre-Construction Manager to serve as the primary liaison between Real Estate, Design Engineering, Construction and other critical partner teams during initial planning, conceptual design and design development; providing cost, schedule, and constructibility guidance.
Our pre-Construction Managers are on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers and are known for changing the face of cloud computing. As a pre-Construction Manager you will support the development and implementation of design standards across regional construction programs and will create and release high quality, consistent documentation for processes, standards and procedures.
Our goal is to find the candidate that has highly developed critical facility pre-construction knowledge coupled with extensive practical construction experience to drive standards in this essential part of our delivery process.

If you have experience driving global pre-construction standards, bid documents, specifications and general requirements to describe all the elements of a construction project and working within a broad design and construction infrastructure environment, then this could be your role!


Key job responsibilities
-You will review and provide input into global standards and data center template designs.
-You will independently support, overview and manage complex, cross-functional Data Center projects from site selection, permitting and contract execution, and keep project stakeholders informed to contribute to the performance of the team, building trust and respect in all working relationships.
-You will keep the scope progress under control a by driving crisp and timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and escalating appropriately.
-You will work with internal/external teams including real estate, design engineering, construction, finance, architects, engineers, permitting agencies, developers and landlords to secure resources, scope infrastructure builds, set priorities, milestones and drive results through clearing blockers, making decisions, leading and influencing.
-You will conduct negotiations with general contractors and evaluate bids/proposals participating in pricing reviews for scope inclusions/exclusions and negotiate the cost of the work with developers, general contractors and design consultants.
-You will evaluate Due Diligences, schedule tracking, and identify and solve factors that may impede a successful permitted project hand-over to Amazon stakeholders.
-You will insist on the highest standards from self and others and drive accountability for results, leading externals, and potentially, internals, including coaching and/or disciplinary actions, as needed



A day in the life
Each day you will represent AWS in ensuring the on time and in budget execution of Amazon projects, while strategically improving its processes, costs, quality H&S, and sustainability performance.
You will be leading and mentoring large cross-functional teams as an expert technical and project management resource to complete construction projects and skillfully motivate and focus people of all levels to deliver.
You will drive significant communication across departments, to front line and executive level managers while serving as an authority on project issues.
You will leverage your experience and tools to understand where gaps exist in project plans and propose solutions.
You will be understanding and negotiating terms of contracts with developers, contractors and consultants representing AWS’ interests. Daily tasks may be comprised of site validation, due diligence and risk analysis, design management, contract/lease and cost negotiations, stakeholder and vendor management.
You will act as the primary escalation point for the evaluation of the feasibility of potential future projects and pre-development actions; owning and tracking issues to ensure that they are addressed, documented, and resolved using influence to manage team members.
You will lead negotiations with general contractors and internal procurement partners and evaluate bids/proposals/claims with detail and accuracy, reporting key construction/commercial metrics, including schedule, cost and budget.
.

Our Pre-Construction team is a multicultural, multinational group on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers and are known for changing the face of cloud computing.

descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都府中市を予定しています。
入社後、数カ月間は他の事業所でトレーニング（出張ベース）をしていただく予定です。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シフトアシスタントとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはアマゾンの新しいエキサイティングな配送拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商
品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！


■業務内容■
具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS DynamoDB
descriptionHtml:
Amazon DynamoDB powers many of the world's fastest-growing businesses, including Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin. It also powers enterprises such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One. Within Amazon, it runs high-traffic properties including Alexa, Amazon.com, and every Amazon fulfillment center. DynamoDB is one of the largest distributed database systems in the world. We believe it is always Day 1, and we keep improving the service and adding new capabilities.

DynamoDB customers count on consistent single-digit millisecond performance at any scale, high availability, and durable data. Testing is how DynamoDB keeps those promises with every change it ships. The Test Infrastructure team builds test frameworks that every DynamoDB engineer uses to validate features, run integration and performance tests, and qualify releases. When test infrastructure is fast and reliable, every DynamoDB team delivers features faster.

Testing is also central to how DynamoDB speeds up delivery as engineers bring AI agents into their development work. An agent can only correct its own mistakes if it can run a change against a realistic system and see the result. Ready-to-run test clusters give agents that feedback loop. The features this team builds let DynamoDB engineers use AI-assisted development for changes that need more than unit tests, and they let DynamoDB add automated testing to every code review and every release.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate the test infrastructure, frameworks, and tooling that power DynamoDB testing.
- Build test infrastructure that AI agents can use on their own, with clusters ready on demand and results, logs, and metrics an agent can act on.
- Treat DynamoDB engineers as your customers. Reduce how long they wait for test results and how often their tests fail because of infrastructure.
- Own features end to end, from design through deployment and operation, and deliver ambiguous projects with minimal guidance.
- Debug failures across services and fix root causes in the system.

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Robot Platform Security, Fauna
descriptionHtml:
Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Senior Software Development Engineer to lead security engineering for our robot platform. You will drive the security of the robot from its boot chain to how it handles data.

The ideal candidate has shipped security features on connected devices. They make sound tradeoffs between protection, customer experience, and delivery speed when requirements are still evolving. They raise the bar across teams by building secure defaults and spreading knowledge of best practices. They want to build a new kind of device and are excited about the challenges and opportunities in bringing it into our lives.

Key job responsibilities
- Own security engineering for Fauna's robot platform: boot chain, operating system, on-device software, and updates
- Build security into the robot's OS and software: secure boot, OS hardening, service isolation and access control, and on-device secrets
- Design how the robot handles what it senses, including on-device processing and data minimization
- Build secure defaults into the robot's shared libraries and its build and release pipeline
- Lead secure design and review of Fauna's cloud services in partnership with Amazon's security and privacy teams
- Lead incident response for the robot platform and drive fixes to root cause

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We believe that future won't arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We're changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We're building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

title: Sr. Supplier Quality Engineer, Infrastructure Reliability & Quality (IRQ)
descriptionHtml:
Our Amazon Web Services Infrastructure Reliability & Quality (IRQ) engineering team provides engineering support for our data center infrastructure mechanical and electrical equipment (Air Handling Unit, Switchgear, Breaker, Panel Board, UPS, Transformers, Generators, ATS etc.) as well as infrastructure security equipment (Cameras, Access Control, etc.) throughout their lifecycle. A critical piece of this support is ensuring the highest level of initial quality and ongoing support from our suppliers.

As a Supplier Quality Engineer you will interface with AWS Engineering teams, Procurement teams, Commissioning teams and suppliers to manage infrastructure equipment quality. Our Supplier Quality Engineer is responsible for supplier qualifications, quality monitoring at supplier sites, supplier quality issue resolution and supplier development and quality improvement initiatives.
If you want to be a part of a team that has a daily impact on company success, this is a great opportunity for you.

In this role you will lead internal and external engagements with engineering, procurement, supply chain management, operations, finance, construction, and suppliers to deliver robust and resilient quality systems at our vendors and within AWS. You will identify supplier quality defects or waste in AWS processes, and drive new processes to eliminate the defects and prevent them from recurring without posing risk to availability. who build custom infrastructure electrical, electro-mechanical and security equipment for AWS. Sr. Supplier Quality Engineers will work closely with AWS product development and engineering teams and with infrastructure equipment vendors to monitor and improve the incoming quality of AWS equipment.


Keys to success in this role include sound judgment and excellent written/verbal communication skills.
Travel required, both international and domestic, approximately 30-50%

-Develop, implement and maintain the supplier quality roadmap across engineering and procurement teams.

-Monitor and report on supplier performance quality metrics and actions. Lead supplier quality issue resolution in partnership with engineering, construction and commissioning teams.

title: Network Services Specialist Solution Architect, AGS-EMEA-Europe South
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about enterprise networking, edge computing, and content delivery? Do you enjoy helping customers design high-performance, secure network architectures that connect their workloads to the world? Come join us!

At Amazon, we've invested deeply in building a resilient, secure, and globally distributed network in the cloud. AWS is looking for an Edge/Network Specialist Solutions Architect for our Europe South team, who will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) helping customers design complex networking and edge delivery solutions spanning connectivity, content delivery, and perimeter protection services.

As part of the team, you will work closely with Europe South customers across all industry verticals to drive adoption of AWS Network Services, including CloudFront, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, PrivateLink, VPC Lattice, Elastic Load Balancing, WAF, and Shield. You will act as a trusted advisor on hybrid connectivity, network security, application delivery, and high-throughput architectures supporting AI/ML, migration, and modernization workloads. Beyond customer engagements, you will create and deliver original content, including white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and presentations, to enable customers and field teams to fully leverage the strength of the AWS network from data center to end user.

Key job responsibilities
As the Network Services Specialist SA for Europe South, you will:
- Act as the regional SME for AWS network and edge services, advising customers on connectivity, content delivery, and perimeter protection architectures.
- Lead technical deep dives, architecture reviews, and hands-on workshops covering CloudFront, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, PrivateLink, VPC Lattice, Elastic Load Balancing, WAF, and Shield.
- Design hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity, zero-trust network segmentation, and high-availability application delivery for enterprise customers.
- Support high-throughput architectures for AI/ML, migration, and modernization workloads.
- Create reusable reference architectures, white papers, and blogs, and present at Summits, re:Invent, and customer events.
- Partner with sales, service teams, and the field community to drive adoption of AWS network services across the region.

A day in the life
You start the day on a customer architecture review, helping an enterprise redesign hybrid connectivity across Direct Connect and Transit Gateway. Midday you run a workshop on edge delivery and perimeter protection, then partner with an account team to unblock a migration networking design. In the afternoon you write a reference architecture for high-throughput AI/ML connectivity and prepare a talk for an upcoming customer event. You work across engineering teams and VP-level stakeholders.

About the team
The Europe South Specialist SA team helps customers get the most from the AWS global network, from data center to end user. We are deep technical experts who pair closely with customers and account teams on their most complex networking and edge challenges. We value hands-on building, original technical content, and customer obsession. We learn fast, share openly, and help each other grow in a collaborative, high-trust environment.

Basic qualifications

- Deep expertise in CDN and Edge Services Hands-on experience with content delivery networks (CloudFront or equivalent), edge compute (Lambda@Edge, CloudFront Functions), Global Accelerator, and perimeter protection architectures (WAF, Shield, Firewall Manager).
- Enterprise networking architecture Advanced knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud networking: Direct Connect (including 100+ Gbps), Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, VPN, and BGP routing.
- Network security and zero-trust design Expertise in network segmentation, PrivateLink, VPC Lattice, security groups, NACLs, and micro-segmentation patterns.
- Application delivery and load balancing Deep understanding of Elastic Load Balancing (ALB, NLB, GWLB), origin architectures, TLS termination, health checking patterns, and high-availability application delivery across regions and edge locations.
- Performance optimization and troubleshooting Ability to diagnose and resolve complex latency, throughput, and connectivity issues across distributed architectures.
- Customer-facing technical leadership Proven ability to lead architectural workshops, deliver technical presentations at events (Summits, re:Invent, customer days), write technical blogs, and create reusable reference architectures. Comfortable presenting to both engineering teams and VP/C-level audiences.

Preferred qualifications

- AI/ML and high-throughput workload connectivity Understanding of network requirements for AI/ML training, fine-tuning, and inference workloads, including high-capacity DX provisioning, placement group networking, EFA, and low-latency connectivity to GPU/Trainium clusters.
- Migration and modernization networking Experience designing network foundations for large-scale cloud migrations (VMware, Oracle, SAP), including DX + TGW bridge connectivity, DNS migration, IP address management, and hybrid routing during cutover periods.

title: Power Electronics Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a Power Electronics Reliability Engineer to own the functional-safety case and the reliability/qualification program for the SST control, protection and power-conversion system.

As a Power Electronics Reliability Engineer you will: 1) define IEC 61508 safety functions and safe-state behavior (STO/SS1/SLS), 2) plan/run HALT/HASS and qualification per the V&V strategy, and 3) deliver a defined safety and reliability scope. You will drive hazard analysis, diagnostic/watchdog requirements, fault-state management, failure analysis and root-cause, and derive MTBF/MTTR and reliability metrics with the required diagnostic coverage. You will maintain safety requirements and traceability, review implementation evidence, coordinate critical-component supplier qualification and corrective actions, and resolve issues across disciplines.

About AIS
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities
Safety architecture:
- Apply IEC 61508 principles to safety-related embedded and control functions.
- Define safety functions and safe-state behavior.
- Coordinate safety requirements with system, FPGA, controls and embedded software architectures.

Protection mechanisms:
- Define and review STO, SS1 and SLS functions as applicable to the architecture.
- Define watchdog and embedded diagnostic requirements.
- Develop and review fault-state management strategies.

Safety lifecycle & verification:
- Maintain safety requirements and traceability.
- Support safety analysis and verification planning.
- Review implementation evidence and safety-related test results.
- Coordinate safety issue resolution across engineering disciplines.

Qualification:
- Plan and execute HALT/HASS and other qualification activities identified in the V&V strategy.
- Define reliability stresses and qualification conditions with engineering teams.
- Track qualification status and evidence.

Failure analysis:
- Perform and coordinate failure analysis.
- Identify recurring failure modes and recommend corrective actions.
- Feed reliability findings back into design margins, safe-state behavior and component selection.

Reliability metrics:
- Track MTBF/MTTR and other reliability indicators.
- Identify reliability and safety risks in critical components and subsystems.
- Use test and field data to prioritize reliability and safety improvements.

Supplier follow-up:
- Coordinate critical-component supplier follow-up.
- Review supplier qualification and reliability evidence.
- Support corrective actions for component-related failures.

SST System Alignment:
- Align the role with the system safety framework without treating SIL2 as a system requirement. system specification references NFPA, UL and IEEE electrical-safety standards; IEC 61508/SIL targets should be established by the product safety strategy if applicable.
- Cover functional protection, fault-state behavior, safe restart inhibition, insulation-monitoring interactions, arc-flash considerations and diagnostic coverage.
- Translate system 15+ year design-life and environmental/structural expectations into reliability stresses and qualification plans.
- Include redundancy/catcher behavior, degradation warnings, fault recovery, thermal derating and critical MV/HV insulation components in both safety and reliability analysis.

A day in the life
In this role, you'll focus on establishing safety architectures and reliability programs for our Solid State Transformer control and protection systems. Your day might include defining safety functions according to IEC 61508 standards, coordinating with embedded software and FPGA teams to align safety requirements with system design, or planning qualification activities like HALT/HASS testing.

You'll analyze field data and test results to identify reliability trends, work with component suppliers to resolve critical issues, and document your findings to inform design improvements. You'll also participate in cross-functional problem-solving sessions where your expertise helps resolve complex safety and reliability challenges that span electrical, software, and systems engineering disciplines.

About the team


Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to celebrate our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and diversity conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We have a career path for you no matter what stage you’re in when you start here. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related experience/ field.
- Reliability-engineering experience in power electronics or industrial systems.
- Experience with IEC 61508 and functional-safety development and/or embedded systems and diagnostics experience.
- Experience documenting design decisions, assumptions, trade-offs, risks and technical specifications.
- Experience using engineering analysis and measured evidence demonstrating strong data-driven problem solving.
- Experience demonstrating maintaining a strong focus on safety, reliability, serviceability and scalable deployment.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering.
- Experience in functional safety (IEC 61508/62061-class) and/or reliability & qualification engineering for electrical/power-electronics systems, including verification.
- Experience with HALT/HASS and failure analysis.
- Demonstrated understanding of safe-state behavior, watchdogs, fault-state management, MTBF/MTTR and reliability metrics.
- Experience working with FPGA, controls and embedded-software teams, and coordinating critical component suppliers.
- Demonstrated operating effectively in a greenfield environment where standards and reference designs may require interpretation and adaptation.

descriptionHtml:

- Draft technical GAAP accounting position papers addressing complex topics, including derivatives/financial instruments (ASC 815), fair value measurement (ASC 820), leasing (ASC 842), consolidation (ASC 810), and commitments (ASC 440), consulting with accounting policy as appropriate
- Research and document complex accounting concepts in clear, concise, and unambiguous language that critically supports proposed conclusions
- Continuously reevaluate existing accounting positions to ensure consistency with the evolving business and regulatory environment
- Support the period-end close process by ensuring accurate and timely completion of all derivative-related accounting entries, reconciliations, and analytical reviews

- Identify, validate, and lead opportunities for standardization of processes across teams
- Drive productivity by simplifying processes, engaging emerging technology, and/or implementing innovative solutions

- Experience with Tableau, Python, SQB, Quicksight, Cognos or or other BI packages

Preferred qualifications

title: Senior Research Scientist, RBS Tech
descriptionHtml:
RBS (Retail Business Services) Tech team works towards enhancing the customer experience (CX) and their trust in product data by providing technologies to find and fix Amazon CX defects at scale. Our platforms help in improving the CX in all phases of customer journey, including selection, discoverability & fulfilment, buying experience and post-buying experience (product quality and customer returns). The team also develops GenAI platforms for automation of Amazon Stores Operations.

As a Sciences team in RBS Tech, we focus on foundational ML research and develop scalable state-of-the-art ML solutions to solve the problems covering customer experience (CX) and Selling partner experience (SPX). We work to solve problems related to multi-modal understanding (text and images), task automation through multi-modal LLM Agents, supervised and unsupervised techniques, multi-task learning, multi-label classification, aspect and topic extraction for Customer Anecdote Mining, image and text similarity and retrieval using NLP and Computer Vision for product groupings and identifying duplicate listings in product search results

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Research Scientist, you will be responsible to design and deploy scalable GenAI, NLP and Computer Vision solutions that will impact the content visible to millions of customer and solve key customer experience issues. You will develop novel LLM, deep learning and statistical techniques for task automation, text processing, image processing, pattern recognition, and anomaly detection problems. You will define the research and experiments strategy with an iterative execution approach to develop AI/ML models and progressively improve the results over time. You will partner with business and engineering teams to identify and solve large and significantly complex problems that require scientific innovation. You will help the team leverage your expertise, by coaching and mentoring. You will contribute to the professional development of colleagues, improving their technical knowledge and the engineering practices. You will independently as well as guide team to file for patents and/or publish research work where opportunities arise. The RBS org deals with problems that are directly related to the selling partners and end customers and the ML team drives resolution to organization level problems. Therefore, the Senior Research Scientist role will impact the large product strategy, identifies new business opportunities and provides strategic direction which is very exciting.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of investigating the feasibility of applying scientific principles and concepts to business problems and products experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 5+ years of quantitative field research experience
- Experience with big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive etc.
- Experience communicating qualitative research methods and findings to non-qualitative researchers

Preferred qualifications

- Experience converting research studies into tangible real-world changes
- Experience with discrete and continuous optimization methodologies and algorithms

title: Sr. Product manager-Technical , Seller Fulfillment Experience (SFX)
descriptionHtml:

This role will own the product vision, define the strategic roadmap, and drive end-to-end delivery of seller-facing experiences that directly impact seller adoption, retention, and operational success across three of Amazon’s fastest-growing marketplaces. You will be responsible for some of the highest-judgment product decisions within FBA’s emerging markets portfolio — decisions that shape how hundreds of thousands of sellers experience fulfillment and how Amazon grows its third-party marketplace in these geographies.

Fulfillment by Amazon is one of Amazon’s most important seller-facing programs, enabling third-party sellers to leverage Amazon’s world-class fulfillment network to delight end customers. The Seller Fulfillment Experience (SFX) team owns the seller journey, workflows, and interfaces that power this program — from shipment creation and inventory planning through performance optimization and product removal. We operate at the intersection of marketplace dynamics, logistics complexity, and seller experience, solving problems that require deep understanding of local nuance, operational constraints, and seller behavioral economics across emerging markets at different stages of maturity.

This role sits within the SFX product team and will own strategic product leadership across interconnected charter areas: (1) product strategy and roadmap definition; translating seller pain points, country opportunity analysis, and business priorities into a cohesive product vision that balances seller experience with operational and economic sustainability; (2) cross-functional delivery leadership; driving alignment across engineering, UX, data science, operations, and business teams to deliver complex, multi-component product experiences on ambitious timelines; and (3) organizational influence and thought leadership; shaping the broader FBA product direction through compelling narratives, data-driven recommendations, and active participation in leadership forums (WBRs, planning cycles, investment reviews).

As an ideal candidate, you are a strategic product leader who combines vision with execution discipline. You thrive in ambiguity and can translate complex, multi-geo challenges into clear product strategies and crisp leadership recommendations. You bring strong analytical skills with the ability to build business cases, evaluate trade-offs across multiple dimensions (seller experience, operational cost, marketplace growth), and drive data-informed decisions at scale. You are comfortable navigating contentious prioritization decisions across organizations with competing perspectives and partnering with engineering, finance, operations, and senior leadership to drive alignment. You think big about how product experiences can accelerate FBA growth in emerging markets while ensuring long-term sustainability, and you mentor and elevate the product managers around you.


Key job responsibilities
• Define and drive the product strategy for a major product area or multiple related product areas within FBA seller experience, setting multi-quarter roadmaps aligned with org vision
• Own complex, ambiguous problem spaces; frame problems, generate innovative solutions, and drive alignment across senior stakeholders and partner teams
• Write and present high-quality product narratives (PRFAQs, strategy docs, business cases) to VP/Director-level leadership, securing buy-in for significant investments
• Lead cross-functional product development efforts spanning engineering, UX, data science, operations, finance, and business teams across multiple geographies
• Establish and monitor key business metrics, building mechanisms to track product performance and identify opportunities at scale
• Drive a culture of experimentation and data-driven decision making; design experimentation frameworks that enable your team to validate assumptions rapidly
• Influence the broader organization’s product direction through thought leadership, best practices, and cross-pollination of ideas across teams
• Mentor and develop Product Managers; provide guidance on product strategy, stakeholder management, and career development
• Navigate geo-specific complexity (regulatory, operational, cultural) to ensure product strategies are adapted for emerging markets while maintaining global scalability
• Identify and drive operational improvements and automation opportunities that create leverage for the team and organization
• Represent your product area in leadership forums (WBRs, business reviews, planning cycles) and proactively escalate risks and trade-offs


A day in the life
As a Senior Product Manager on the SFX team, your morning might begin with reviewing a weekly business review (WBR) pack, identifying inflection points in seller adoption metrics across Brazil or Australia, and framing a narrative for leadership. You’ll lead a strategy session where you guide your team through a complex trade-off, balancing seller experience improvements against operational cost constraints, and land on a clear recommendation backed by data. Between meetings, you’re refining a PRFAQ for a net-new capability that could unlock seller growth in an underserved segment, incorporating feedback from the senior leader review earlier this week.

Afternoons include a cross-org design review where you challenge assumptions and elevate the quality of the proposed seller workflow, followed by coaching a junior PM through their first product narrative. You close the day with a quick sync with your engineering lead to unblock a critical launch dependency, ensuring your team maintains velocity. You thrive in ambiguity, connect dots across multiple workstreams, and consistently deliver products that move the needle for sellers and the business.

About the team
The FBA Seller Fulfillment Experience (SFX) team owns the seller journey and workflows that power Fulfillment by Amazon across emerging and growth countries: Brazil, Mexico, and Australia. We are responsible for making it easy, transparent, and rewarding for sellers to leverage Amazon’s world-class fulfillment network. Our mission is to remove friction from the seller journey, from listing creation and inventory management to shipment tracking and performance optimization, enabling sellers to grow their business while delighting end customers with fast, reliable delivery.

title: Sr. Product Manager Tech - AWS, Global System Integration
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We keep the cloud running: the data centers and all the power, cooling, networking, and structural systems behind them.

Within that, the Global System Integration team builds the next generation of data center products. We are accountable for cost per megawatt, construction cycle time, on-time launch, design error rates, embedded carbon, and labor moved off site.

As a Sr. Product Manager - Technical, you own the business case for a data center product or platform. You define the problem worth solving: the cost target, the customer need, and the limits the design must meet. You help the team make real tradeoffs, and you stay accountable from first concept to the final megawatt delivered.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the business case for each product or platform you carry, defining the cost target, customer need, constraint set, and measure of success.
- Set and defend the constraint box Engineering solves within, drawing the cost, schedule, sustainability, and buildability limits from the business case.
- Govern design change, the largest controllable cost driver, by being the test every proposed change passes or fails on whether it earns its cost and schedule hit against the case.
- Own the full chain from design decision to delivered megawatt.
- Prioritize across the portfolio when new demand arrives, deciding what gets staffed and what slips, naming the cost of leaving a product understaffed, and tying every staffing ask to a specific product and tier so the tradeoffs stay explicit and documented.
- Author and defend the business case in the operating plans, reviews, and strategy papers that release capital, and turn repeatable product judgment into decision-support mechanisms the organization can run without you.


A day in the life
You start by checking the products you own against their cases: is cost on target, are dates holding without burning buffer, are design errors trending down. In a design review, you judge not the engineering but whether a proposed change earns its cost and schedule hit and whether anyone has signed off the departure. When new demand lands, you decide what it displaces and write that tradeoff down so it is traceable. You draft a business case for an operating-plan review, coach a PM through theirs, and close an open sign-off before it re-opens first principles.

Basic qualifications

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

descriptionHtml:
The AWS Security Incident Response team is looking for a Security Engineer to help protect the AWS infrastructure that our national security customers rely on. You will join a growing team that handles incident response in AWS GovCloud and U.S. Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) regions, along with other security requirements specific to our government customers.

You will analyze logs, investigate and respond to security events, support forensic investigations, and help build the tools that let the team work faster and at greater scale. You'll work with engineers across AWS to contain issues and stop them from happening again, and you'll learn to explain risks clearly to different audiences. Working with senior engineers, you pull logs, collect forensic evidence, and help contain the issue. Midday, you write a script that automates a manual step from the investigation. title: Hardware Development Engineer, OneMHS - Electrical and Controls Engineering Architecture and Design
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Hardware Development Engineer to serve as a technical authority for industrial controls network architecture and controls hardware within Amazon's global fulfillment center network. This role will define, standardize, and evolve the EtherCAT-based controls architecture used across material handling systems. You will focus on network topology, device selection, functional safety integration, scalability, and operational excellence. As part of OneMHS (One Material Handling Systems), you will help transform how Amazon designs, builds, and operates its material handling capabilities through standardized, high-performance controls hardware.
The ideal candidate has a proven track record in industrial network design, controls hardware integration, and device selection for complex material handling systems, including tote/parcel conveyance and sortation. You will work closely with Controls Software, WWDE, Operations Engineering, strategic suppliers, integration partners, and cross-functional teams to deliver robust, maintainable controls architectures.
This role requires deep technical expertise to create architecture standards and approved component baselines that guide vendor designs and multi-year roadmaps. It also requires the tactical execution to review designs, resolve integration issues, and improve the clarity and quality of project deliverables.

Key job responsibilities
EtherCAT Network Architecture & Topology
- Define and maintain the OneMHS EtherCAT controls architecture, including topology, ring and cable-redundancy design, segmentation, and device-order rules
- Develop architecture diagrams, and network topology drawings, and establish network design limits such as device counts per segment, cycle-time and latency budgets, and safety-connection capacity
- Define addressing, naming, and identification standards for devices, ports, and cables
- Establish network diagnostics, fault isolation, and troubleshooting practices for operations and maintenance teams
Device Selection, Qualification & Component Standards
- Select, specify, and qualify controls hardware for the architecture, including industrial PCs, couplers, I/O, MDR controllers, VFDs, IO-Link masters and devices, safety devices, scanners, sensors, and controls power supplies
- Own the approved component list, including exact part numbers, firmware/hardware revisions, and device profiles
- Evaluate new and alternate components for technical fit, compliance (e.g., UL, Class 2/LVLE), cost, availability, and lifecycle risk
- Partner with suppliers on technical requirements, certification status, product roadmaps, and obsolescence management
- Develop substitution and change-approval criteria for vendors and integration partners
Functional Safety Integration
- Define the integration of safety devices and safety-over-fieldbus (e.g., FSoE) into the controls architecture
- Establish safety-controller allocation, safety-zone, and E-stop integration rules in coordination with Safety and Controls teams
- Support compliance with applicable functional safety standards (e.g., ISO 13849, IEC 62061)
Hardware Development, Prototyping & Validation
- Build and maintain test benches and lab environments to validate devices, topologies, and failure modes
- Lead prototype testing, interoperability testing, and production-readiness validation of new hardware and architectures
- Support factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, and commissioning of controls hardware
OneMHS Program Specifications
- Author and maintain controls architecture specifications, device integration requirements, and cabling standards
- Define vendor deliverables for controls hardware, including device schedules, topology drawings, and bills of material
- Review integrator and OEM designs for compliance with OneMHS architecture and component standards
- Drive continuous improvement of specification templates and documentation for scaled deployment
Standards & Code Compliance
- Ensure controls hardware designs comply with NEC/NFPA 70, NFPA 79, UL 508A, and applicable IEC standards
- Serve as subject matter expert on industrial networking, controls hardware, and low-voltage controls requirements
- Conduct design reviews and audits to identify compliance gaps and safety risks
- Stay current with EtherCAT Technology Group guidance, industry standards, and regulatory changes
Technical Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing
- Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and designers
- Lead design reviews for controls architecture and hardware at site and program levels
- Collaborate with Controls Software, Operations, Facilities, Construction, WWDE, and Safety teams
- Build consensus across stakeholders, suppliers, and integration partners on architecture decisions

A day in the life
Collaborate with Controls Software, integration partners, and suppliers to define and refine the EtherCAT architecture for upcoming fulfillment center projects. Review vendor topology drawings and device schedules, evaluate a new device for inclusion in the approved component list, and work through an integration question with a supplier's engineering team. Validate a new topology or device in the lab before it reaches the field, and support a site team troubleshooting a commissioning issue.
Develop mechanisms that make controls hardware implementations repeatable across multiple simultaneous projects while maintaining the highest standards of safety, reliability, and performance.

About the team
One MHS is the central material handling systems organization within Amazon's global fulfillment center network. Our engineering teams design and deliver state-of-the-art power, hardware, and controls systems that keep the world's supply chains moving. We are committed to excellence, safety, and the professional growth of every team member.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related fields
- 4+ years of experience in industrial controls hardware design, industrial network architecture, or automation hardware development
- Experience designing and deploying industrial Ethernet or fieldbus networks (e.g., EtherCAT, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET)
- Experience selecting, specifying, and integrating industrial field devices such as I/O, drives, sensors, and safety devices
- Experience creating or reviewing electrical and controls drawings, network diagrams, and device schedules
- Knowledge of NEC/NFPA 70, NFPA 79, and UL 508A as applied to control panels and field wiring

Preferred qualifications

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, EC2 Instance Networking
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build the networking infrastructure that powers every virtual machine in the world's largest cloud? Are you excited by the challenge of writing systems software that runs on millions custom networking cards across millions of hosts?

The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) Instance Networking team builds and operates the software-defined networking stack at the heart of AWS. Our code is what makes Virtual Private Clouds (VPC) work, what enforces customer security policies, and what enables workloads to scale from a single instance to clusters of tens of thousands. Every packet that enters or leaves an EC2 instance flows through software we write, running on custom silicon designed in-house.

This work sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and the AI revolution. As machine learning workloads grow to unprecedented scale - training runs spanning thousands of accelerators, clusters demanding millions of network endpoints, and fabrics pushing hundreds of gigabits per second. We build the networking primitives that make these workloads possible: high-performance interfaces, low-latency data plane protocols, and scalable network virtualization that operates predictably even under heavy churn. When the world's most ambitious AI companies scale on AWS, they're relying on the software we build.

You'll write low-level systems code in C and Rust running on custom hardware in a real-time
embedded environment. You'll work on network virtualization protocols, packet processing pipelines, and availability mechanisms that must perform correctly at massive scale with sub-second latency requirements. You'll solve problems that span hardware, firmware, and
software, and see the direct impact of your work on customers running some of the largest and most demanding workloads in the cloud.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and mentor junior engineers on impactful and challenging projects
- Design and implement data plane networking software on custom hardware, working across the full software lifecycle from design through deployment and operations
- Build and improve network virtualization systems that deliver VPC connectivity, security policy enforcement, and performance isolation for EC2 customers
- Investigate and resolve complex production issues across distributed embedded systems, driving root cause analysis and permanent fixes
- Collaborate with partner teams across hardware, control plane, and ML platforms to deliver end-to-end solutions

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 7+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 7+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst, Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC) team ensures that Amazon transactions satisfy legal and safety requirements in accordance to the guidelines across global marketplaces. We proactively identify risks involved for Amazon while doing business in various countries and enable smooth flow of products across international borders. A Sr. Compliance Associate- Quality Analyst is responsible for protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, hazardous, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited /regulated by Law and Amazon policies.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

Skills:
• Proficiency in verbal & written communication in English
• Good working knowledge of MS Office, MS Outlook; MS Excel. Proficiency is an advantage.
• Strong attention to details.
• Ability to analyze and identify patterns in large data sets.
• Decision making aptitudes based on given guidelines and in ambiguous contexts.
• Must be comfortable working with large data sets.
• Very good knowledge and experience in internet navigation and research – finding specific information about products in a timely manner.

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- 1+ years of data-driven business operations processes experience
- Business Process Outsourcing, Operations processes; Database management is an added advantage

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
- Experience as a quality auditor in retail chain management / FMCG company / Corporate role
- Experience in designing and implementing custom reporting systems using automation tools
- Experience with data analysis in a variety of quantitative fields and experience building data and decision support systems
- Knowledge of database query technologies (SQL)

title: Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you'll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

Key job responsibilities
-Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
-Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
-Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
-Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
-Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices

A day in the life
You'll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You'll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation. A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. You'll also be a role model and mentor to new managers.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we're always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we're known for. We're based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon's fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the 'First Mile' because it's where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

Basic qualifications

- A degree or equivalent qualification
- Relevant experience in people management
- Relevant experience of communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including your peers and leadership
- Relevant experience in using qualitative and quantitative data to support business decisions
- Proficiency in English and Arabic, both verbal and written (CEFR C1)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with Lean, Six Sigma and Kaizen techniques
- Experience working in another logistics environment
- Relevant experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment

title: Legal Counsel, Egypt Operations, WW Operations
descriptionHtml:
Want to help build the future of how Egypt shops, moves, and gets things delivered? Amazon's operations in Egypt are growing fast and we're looking for a bold, curious attorney to grow with us.

If you love untangling hard problems, working shoulder-to-shoulder with builders, and being the go-to lawyer who makes big ideas happen the right way, this role was made for you. We're customer-obsessed, we move fast, and we have fun doing it.

As Corporate Counsel for WW Operations, based in Cairo, you'll be the primary lawyer behind our fulfillment, logistics, and last-mile delivery teams in Egypt including some of the most exciting frontiers in the business: quick commerce and micro-mobility. This is a chance to be part of both a regional and global team, with real opportunities to collaborate, grow as a trusted advisor in region, and shape work that matters well beyond Egypt's borders.

Key job responsibilities
• Act as the trusted legal partner across a broad canvas — environment, health and safety, compliance, transportation, last-mile and micro-mobility operations, and sustainability.
• Advise on new delivery models, including quick commerce and micro-mobility, often writing the playbook as the regulatory landscape takes shape.
• Guide business and tech teams through regulatory, privacy, and data protection frameworks (including Egypt's data protection framework and cross-border data).
• Partner on emerging technology and artificial intelligence to drive strategic improvements.
• Collaborate across business, compliance, finance, HR, PR, technology, the wider legal team, and Public Policy.
• Engage directly with regulators and think several moves ahead on pre-litigation disputes.
• Share expertise through regular training that levels up the teams you support.

A day in the life
No two days will look the same. You could start your morning helping shape a new quick commerce model or exploring how to bring micro-mobility services to market. By midday, you might be working with product and tech teams on privacy, data protection or the responsible use of AI.

Your afternoon could take you into a conversation with regulators, preparing for a potential dispute or helping teams make sense of new regulations and what they mean for the business.

And in between all of this, you'll be building relationships, asking the right questions, spotting risks early and finding ways to turn complex legal and regulatory challenges into practical solutions.

At its heart, this is a role for someone who wants to be close to the action — working alongside the people building the business, not just advising from the sidelines. You'll help shape what's next, make sense of what's changing and enable ambitious ideas to become reality, responsibly and confidently.

This is an individual contributor role based in Cairo. Some domestic and international travel may be required.

About the team
You'll join a team that speaks candidly and welcomes bold ideas. While this role is rooted in Egypt, you'll team up with colleagues across our global WW Operations legal community to shape projects that matter well beyond our borders. Come build something you're proud of.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of post bar admission legal experience
- Licensed to practice Law in Egypt, or a common law jurisdiction
- Fluent Arabic
- Excellent English, both spoken and written

- Experience of a mix of corporate law firm and in-house work
- Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)
- Ability to demonstrate sound judgment even in ambiguous situations
- Ability to work independently while being able to contribute successfully to cross-functional teams
- Excellent organizational skills, ability to manage multiple projects at once, follow through and meet deadlines
- Experience advising on data privacy, technology, or AI / emerging-technology matters

title: Logistics Program Mgr., AWS Cloud Logistics
descriptionHtml:
As a Transportation Operations Manager, you will serve as the connective tissue between operations execution and performance measurement across both logistics and warehousing services. You will own the full metrics lifecycle — from establishing goals and targets, to tracking performance, to reporting actuals vs. targets for stakeholders across the network. You will simultaneously drive day-to-day operations execution while identifying and implementing structural efficiency improvements that reduce cost, improve throughput, and elevate service levels.

Key job responsibilities
Design and own the performance metrics framework for transportation and warehousing operations, establishing baseline targets, stretch goals, and tolerance thresholds across key indicators including on-time delivery, warehouse utilization, and carrier performance
Partner with Operations teams and senior leadership to align metrics targets with organizational objectives and network strategy goals
Build and maintain a unified scorecard spanning both logistics (carrier, lane, mode) and warehousing (throughput, labor, space utilization) dimensions, ensuring end-to-end supply chain visibility
Reporting & Actuals vs. Targets Tracking

Develop and publish recurring performance reports — daily, weekly, and monthly — tracking actuals against established targets and surfacing variance trends requiring intervention
Build automated reporting pipelines and dashboards that translate raw operational data into clear, actionable insights for operations managers and senior leadership
Own root cause analysis for metric deviations, documenting findings and driving corrective action plans with accountable stakeholders
Support QBR and MBR reporting cycles with structured narratives that contextualize performance trends against operational and market conditions
Operations Execution

Lead day-to-day transportation and warehousing operations execution, ensuring service continuity, compliance with SOPs, and alignment with carrier and LSP commitments
Serve as an escalation point for operational issues — carrier failures, capacity shortfalls, warehouse throughput bottlenecks — coordinating rapid resolution across internal teams and 3P providers
Operational Efficiency & Continuous Improvement

Identify inefficiencies across transportation lanes and warehousing operations through data analysis, and develop structured improvement initiatives with measurable outcomes
Build and maintain a continuous improvement pipeline — tracking initiative status, projected savings, and realized impact against plan
Develop supplier and carrier performance measurement frameworks that drive accountability and continuous improvement
Partner with category, procurement, and systems teams to align operational efficiency initiatives with broader network strategy and cost reduction goals
Stakeholder Alignment & Cross-functional Partnership

Align with building leadership, regional operations, Finance, and centralized procurement to ensure metrics and efficiency programs reflect both site-level realities and network-wide priorities
Develop relationships across the operations network to ensure best practices in reporting, tracking, and performance management are shared and implemented consistently

A day in the life
The day kicks off reviewing overnight carrier performance dashboards — two lanes missed on-time targets, triggering a root cause deep dive before 8am. By mid-morning, you're in a standup with LSP partners, working through a warehouse throughput bottleneck flagged in yesterday's actuals-vs-targets report. Lunch is spent refining an automated reporting pipeline ahead of next week's MBR. The afternoon brings a cross-functional call with systems and regional ops to align on Q3 efficiency targets. Before signing off, you're updating the continuous improvement tracker — one initiative just hit its projected performance milestone.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent experience
- 5+ years of implementing metric-based strategies utilizing continuous improvement concepts experience
- 2+ years of program, project or product management, or leading product implementation experience
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field
- 6+ years of experience in high-volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments, including global supply chain management and leading cross-functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies
- Experience in negotiations with global suppliers with a proven track record in cost reduction
